sources.note: A large multi-file adversarial re-verification effort (STEP-VERIFY-nnn-nnn spec files + TV-F-nnn findings files under docs/knowledgeos/brainstorming/verification/) that reads corpus theory-building files in full and grades definitions/derivations/computability/tests/DDD-quality, registering numbered contradictions (VC-n) and cross-checking prior corpus claims; overlaps in method and some findings with the B0035/B0036 STEP-TRACE series and the invariant-consolidation/state-transition verification plans but appears to be a separately-run, more recent pass (dated 2026-08-30) specifically covering steps 026-040 and onward -- relationship to those prior verification efforts not reconciled in this batch.

A large multi-file adversarial re-verification effort (STEP-VERIFY-nnn-nnn spec files + TV-F-nnn findings files under docs/knowledgeos/brainstorming/verification/) that reads corpus theory-building files in full and grades definitions/derivations/computability/tests/DDD-quality, registering numbered contradictions (VC-n) and cross-checking prior corpus claims; overlaps in method and some findings with the B0035/B0036 STEP-TRACE series and the invariant-consolidation/state-transition verification plans but appears to be a separately-run, more recent pass (dated 2026-08-30) specifically covering steps 026-040 and onward -- relationship to those prior verification efforts not reconciled in this batch.

experiment.hypothesis: The corpus's ~190 PASS labels across steps 026-040 correspond to executed tests.
experiment.setup: grep over all 17 files for language-tagged fences and execution/reproducibility keywords.
experiment.assumptions: Execution evidence would leave a textual trace (fence tag, command output, keyword).
experiment.inputs: 17 markdown files, steps 026-040 plus two meta files.
experiment.method: grep -oE fence-tag pattern; grep -inE execution-keyword pattern; grep -c PASS.
experiment.result: 62 fences all ```text/bare; 0 language-tagged; 0 reproducibility hits; ~190 PASS tokens.
experiment.interpretation: All PASS labels are author assertions, not test results.
experiment.limitations: Grep-based; cannot detect execution evidence embedded outside fences or in a form grep does not match.
experiment.conclusion: TESTABLE is reached zero times across the 17-file scope.

rows.anchor: grep -oE '^```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*' over all 17 files returns exactly two fence types: bare ``` and ```text — 62 fences, zero language-tagged
rows.statement: Global execution-evidence sweep across all 17 audited files: exactly 62 code fences, all bare/```text, zero language-tagged; zero hits for reproducibility/execution-log keywords; no file contains an executed computation, command output, solver invocation, dataset, or sample size; every one of ~190 'PASS' tokens is an author-written label, not a test result.

rows.anchor: §26.21 `Sufficient(E,q)` — NOT_DEFINED, oracle ... §26.41 observability matrix ... Kalman rank condition, correctly stated
rows.statement: Step-026 (model boundary/observability/identifiability) verdict: definitions PARTIALLY_CLEAR (pi, ~_O, identifiability, observability matrix CLEAR; Sufficient(E,q), InformationLoss, ModelContract, ModelCritique, CanJustify NOT_DEFINED); five uncited re-derivations of earlier steps 013/014/016/020/023 identified; computability stops at DEFINED (INPUTS_KNOWN fails); all seven 'falsification experiments' are AUTHOR_ASSERTED_PASS with no inputs/system/output.

rows.anchor: Is this axis the same decomposition as step-020's 8 TYPES ... NO — it is a FORK, not a refinement
rows.statement: Step-027's U(H) 8-vector (measurement/epistemic/aleatoric/model/semantic/identity/temporal/causal, partitioning uncertainty by causal origin in the pipeline) is an uncited FORK against step-020's 8 TYPES (partitioning the logical/representational shape of an unknown) -- two orthogonal, unreconciled 8-way taxonomies over the same symbol space, plus a third incompatible 5-term U-decomposition (U_D) in the same file 39 sections later.

rows.anchor: Contradiction(A,B) iff Context(A)≈Context(B) ∧ A⊨¬B — ILL-TYPED ... FIRST INVALID INFERENCE, §28.44
rows.statement: Step-028's conflict/contradiction formalism is load-bearing on an undefined context-similarity relation (Context(A)≈Context(B)); its non-explosion/containment invariant is stipulated, not derived; the file's first invalid inference (§28.44) presupposes a well-defined containment boundary that classical logic with a functionality axiom for Version would not actually respect, requiring an unspecified paraconsistent or relevance-logic mechanism.

rows.anchor: A satisfying assignment does not 'may' exist; it demonstrably DOES exist ... §29.24 ... ASSERTED, NOT ARGUED
rows.statement: Step-029's worked SAT example ((A∨B)∧(¬A∨C)) is verifier-recomputed to have 4 satisfying models, contradicting the source's hedge 'may exist'; the file's 'no SMT solver needed everywhere' decision criterion is asserted with no complexity claim, no cost model, and no classification procedure for 'simple' vs solver-requiring constraints, while its own companion meta file lists complexity analysis as 'Not yet analyzed'.

rows.anchor: Brier ... correct ... log-loss is undefined (−∞ penalty) at p∈{0,1} on a wrong call — no clipping/ε convention is specified ... §30.59 ... fully executable test that was not executed
rows.statement: Step-030's Brier score and log-loss formulas are verified mathematically correct, but log-loss is left undefined at p in {0,1} with no epsilon-clipping convention specified (precisely the failure mode a KnowledgeOS asserting P=1.0 would hit); its ten falsification experiments are all AUTHOR_ASSERTED_PASS, and §30.59 is flagged as the single most damaging unexecuted-but-fully-executable test in the 17-file scope.

rows.anchor: M1 — Type correctness ... M7 — Computational feasibility ... step-031, which is explicitly commissioned to be this gate, never once references M1–M7 by name
rows.statement: The step-030-analysis meta file's M1-M7 review gate (type/semantic/composability/uncertainty/temporal/contradiction-safety/computational-feasibility correctness) is commissioned as Step 31's task but never applied by step-031, which substitutes a different 12-category A-L classification instead; grep for 'M1' across step-031 returns zero hits -- registered as VC-10.

rows.anchor: STEP 31 ... THE LOAD-BEARING FILE ... TWO ILL-TYPINGS IN ONE LINE ... IS THE UPGRADE EARNED BY ANYTHING IN §31.69? NO
rows.statement: Step-031 (the corpus's designated formal audit) is found ILL-TYPED at its own type universe (undeclared P, colliding V symbol, untyped sigma, colliding G=(V,E)); its status upgrade to 'Structurally Sound + Mathematically Coherent at the Core' (§31.70) is ruled unearned on four independent grounds (coherence undefined while the proof calculus is OPEN; no new evidence beyond a mostly oracle-gated/circular counterexample set; the upgrade's own §31.75 'no contradiction' line is refuted by two in-file contradictions VC-1/VC-2; and it reverses the commissioning meta-file's calibrated verdict on no new evidence) -- called a relabelling, not a finding.

rows.anchor: CE tally: genuinely derivable ... CE4, CE5, CE13, CE16 (4/20) ... circular ... oracle ... ill-posed ... not actually tested
rows.statement: Of step-031's twenty counterexamples CE1-CE20, verifier re-derivation classifies only 4 as genuinely derivable from the file's own §31.1-31.48 definitions (CE4, CE5, CE13, CE16), 4 as circular axiom-restatements, 7 as gated on undefined oracles or silently imported from uncited earlier steps, 1 as ill-posed (vacuous), and 1 (CE11) as not actually tested despite being labelled 'PASS conceptually'.

rows.anchor: §32.34 ... immediately self-invalidated at §32.34's own next line ... §32.79 ... a fourth competing spine object
rows.statement: Step-032's Status(A) six-value enum is declared and then withdrawn as non-mutually-exclusive within the same section; its EpistemicClaim EC 11-tuple is identified as a fourth competing 'spine' object alongside step-031's 6-tuple assertion, 7-tuple K_t, and its own 5-tuple State(A); its Belnap-FOUR-equivalent lattice claim is neither named nor cited as Belnap's bilattice, and no join/meet operation is ever defined.

rows.anchor: §33.29 Y=X^2 ... This is the single best worked example in the 17-file scope ... §33.76 Risk = Uncertainty × Consequence ... the only place in the scope where a slogan is retracted in favour of its formal counterpart
rows.statement: Step-033 (uncertainty propagation) is rated the strongest derivation record in the 17-file scope -- every numeric propagation (delta method, covariance, interval arithmetic including the non-monotone X^2 example, Bayesian model averaging, minimax regret) checks out under verifier re-derivation, and it contains the scope's only self-correction of a slogan ('Risk=Uncertainty x Consequence') back to its formal definition (Risk(a)=E[L(a,Y)]); nonetheless all its interval computations are three-line hand calculations, never executed as code, and Sigma/priors are never populated with data.

rows.anchor: §34.5 EVPI=L_0-L_PI ... EVPI≥0 is guaranteed and the file does not state it ... §34.6 Cost(I) ... ill-typed in retrospect
rows.statement: Step-034's EVPI/EVSI/NVOI decision-theoretic core is verified correct and re-derives step-015's EVSI with zero citation; several free non-negativity invariants (EVPI>=EVSI>=0) go unstated; its scalar Cost(I) in NVOI=EVSI(I)-Cost(I) becomes ill-typed in retrospect once step-035 §35.39 redefines Cost as a 5-vector without noting the break (VC-5).

rows.anchor: §35.24 ... NP-hard in general ... TRUE but UNPROVED ... §35.75's boxed conclusion ... NOT_DERIVED ... FIRST INVALID INFERENCE: §35.75
rows.statement: Step-035's portfolio-optimization NP-hardness claim is judged true but unproved (no reduction, no approximation ratio, and its own §35.27 constructs a supermodular case for which the greedy bound explicitly fails); its boxed conclusion that 'the mathematical architecture does not inherently require a supercomputer' is ruled NOT_DERIVED because 3 of the 8 listed operation families (constraint checking/SAT, optimization, Bayesian inference) are precisely the ones already shown intractable two sections earlier.

rows.anchor: §36.7 ... verbatim duplicates of step-030 §30.8–30.9, uncited ... The file states the requirement it violates two pages earlier ... §36.49 ... 8-tuple H ... vs §36.80 ... 6-tuple
rows.statement: Step-036's calibration/meta-validation layer duplicates step-030's Brier/log-loss formulas uncited, then internally violates its own later-stated requirement (SE and sample size for every meta-metric) with the same undated formulas; it defines two incompatible 'health/meta' vectors (8-tuple H at §36.49 vs 6-tuple MetaState_t at §36.80, VC-7) and boxes a 4-kind drift family that silently omits 4 of the 6 drift kinds it had just enumerated (VC-8).

rows.anchor: §37.16 ... a one-player optimization labelled 'game-theoretic reasoning' ... there is no game ... §37.29 ... MISATTRIBUTION
rows.statement: Step-037's adversarial-epistemology layer labels a one-player optimization as 'game-theoretic reasoning' with no opponent strategy space or equilibrium concept defined; it misattributes step-026's identifiability foundation to Step 31 (itself an uncited restatement of step-026); its own adversarial/strategic-actor assumption is never propagated into steps 038-040, which revert to a neutral-source model (VC-9).

rows.anchor: §38.17 ... the only place in the scope where a numerical counterexample is actually constructed ... §38.35 ... the only place in 17 files where the aggregate pattern is used correctly and load-bearingly
rows.statement: Step-038 (identity/entity resolution) contains the scope's only genuinely constructed numerical counterexample (sim(A,B)=0.95, sim(B,C)=0.95, sim(A,C)=0.60 defeating transitive closure at threshold 0.9) and its only correct load-bearing use of the DDD aggregate pattern (AggregateIdentity), but 'Similarity(x,y)' -- load-bearing for the entire file's argument -- is never defined, and the counterexample's own transitive closure is never actually run.

rows.anchor: §39.16 ... the single most mathematically mature sentence in the corpus ... §39.47 ... pigeonhole ... §39.49 correctly refuses to equate semantic information with Shannon entropy
rows.statement: Step-039 (bounded-context translation) is rated the strongest DDD file in the scope, correctly using standard DDD vocabulary (Anti-Corruption Layer, context map, per-context Ubiquitous Language) and containing a correctly-hedged information-theoretic argument (deterministic translation cannot increase entropy, but H(A)>H(B) is evidence of possible loss, not proof of semantic invalidity, via a pigeonhole-forced lossy 3-to-2 status mapping example); its core notion 'Meaning(x|C)' is nonetheless never defined anywhere in the 17-file scope despite being load-bearing for every lossless/lossy determination.

rows.anchor: §40.4 contradiction ... a THIRD contradiction definition in scope ... §40.21 Authority(a,c,d) ... Registered as VC-3 ... §40.41 ... the only correct complexity bound on a concrete operation in 17 files
rows.statement: Step-040 introduces a third, unreconciled contradiction definition (after step-028 and step-031's), a conflict-state enum that silently grows from 5 to 9 members with no migration note, and an Authority(a,c,d) that drops the proposition and time arguments of step-028's Authority(S,H,C,t) -- directly contradicting step-028's own boxed 'Authority is proposition-specific' (VC-3) -- while also containing the scope's only correct stated complexity bound on a concrete operation (O(|V_affected|+|E_affected|) dependency traversal, §40.41).

rows.anchor: From Step 41 onward, every theoretical step should produce four artifacts ... this is the single most important sentence in the 17-file scope, and it is a confession
rows.statement: The post-Step-40 review's four-artifact mandate (mathematical definition / DDD interpretation / software abstraction / executable falsification tests, replacing 'Concept->PASS' with 'Mathematics->DDD->Software->Test') is read by the verifier as the corpus's own admission that Steps 26-40 produced exactly Concept->PASS and nothing more; the mandate binds only Step 41 onward and does not retroactively require re-testing steps 26-40.

rows.anchor: Implementation ~30% is not supportable at any reading ... no code exists anywhere in the corpus
rows.statement: The post-Step-40 review's self-labelled 'architectural judgment estimate' progress bars are found unsupportable at the Implementation (~30%, against zero source files in the corpus) and Verification (~15%, against only author-asserted PASS labels) rows, though the disclaimer distinguishing them from measured metrics is itself judged good practice.

rows.anchor: VC-1 — U(H) type contradiction ... VC-2 — CE4 vs CE12 ... VC-3 — Authority arity regression ... VC-4 ... VC-5 ... VC-6 ... VC-7 ... VC-8 ... VC-9 ... VC-10 ... VC-11 ... VC-12
rows.statement: Twelve intra-scope contradictions (VC-1 through VC-12) are individually registered with severity notes, spanning: U(H) type conflict, CE4/CE12 inconsistent model-matching criteria (both located inside the file claiming zero internal contradictions), Authority arity regression, consistency-decomposition reversal (vector vs conjunction), Cost scalar-vs-vector break, an internal metric-rigor violation, two incompatible health vectors in one file, a truncated drift-kind box, the unpropagated adversarial premise, the abandoned M1-M7 gate, an unearned status upgrade, and the corpus's own 'no fundamental contradiction' claim being refuted by the first three.

rows.anchor: of the ~50 headline boxes above, the overwhelming majority are negative separations of the form X ≠ Y ... a separation is not a construction
rows.statement: Structural observation across ~50 catalogued headline boxed claims from steps 026-040: the dominant rhetorical move is a negative separation 'X != Y' (Unknown!=0.5, Similarity!=Identity, Optimal!=Authorized, etc.), which is cheap to assert/defend and usually correct but is 'not a construction' -- it specifies what not to write, not what to write; only three boxed claims in the scope are positive constructions (EpistemicTypeSafety, evidence-append-vs-belief-revise separation, I*=argmax NVOI), and only the third is fully specified enough to implement.

rows.anchor: COMPUTABILITY LADDER — scope-wide ... TESTABLE: reached zero times ... CONSTRUCTIBLE: reached for exactly four operations
rows.statement: Scope-wide computability-ladder summary across all 17 files: DEFINED reached broadly; INPUTS_KNOWN fails almost everywhere (no world-space, observation function, covariance, prior, loss function, similarity metric, calibration dataset, or constraint encoding ever supplied as data); CONSTRUCTIBLE reached for exactly four operations (dependency/transitive closure, SCC detection, blocking-plus-pairwise entity resolution, event-fold projection); COMPUTABLE reached in principle for several statistical formulas and SAT, all blocked at INPUTS_KNOWN; TESTABLE reached zero times.

rows.anchor: POSSIBLE REPAIRS (recorded separately; none applied, none authorized)
rows.statement: The report closes with seven unauthorized possible repairs it explicitly declines to apply: designate one canonical K_t and U(H) with published migrations; withdraw step-031's unearned status upgrade and correct its 'NONE SO FAR' contradiction claim; mint IDs for the ~50 headline boxes and require citation over restatement; restore Authority's proposition/time arguments; execute the six identified low-cost falsification tests; apply M1-M7 to steps 26-40 or formally retire the gate; extend the four-artifact mandate retroactively to steps 26-40.

rows.anchor: Step 208 — NON-EXISTENT / NO SOURCE FOUND (forward-referenced by step-207 §closing; title and agenda specified; no file). Corpus is now 465 files
rows.statement: Corpus-count correction recorded as a verification result: the corpus holds 207 written steps (001-207), not 208; 'Step 208 — Semantic Contract Algebra' is announced in step-207's closing pointer but has no corresponding file, classified NON-EXISTENT/NO SOURCE FOUND; total corpus size given as 465 files.

rows.anchor: Boundary test: PARTIALLY_CLEAR — it rests on Meaning(·|·), which is undefined ... §206.16 boundary score: NOT ESTABLISHED — measurement-theoretic defect ... precisely the construction the corpus has repeatedly rejected
rows.statement: Step-206's bounded-context boundary test Meaning(x|BC_i)!=Meaning(x|BC_j) is ruled PARTIALLY_CLEAR because Meaning is one of the corpus's already-flagged undefined oracles; its weighted boundary score B(i,j)=sum(w_i D_i) is ruled NOT ESTABLISHED because none of the five divergence components (D_L,D_I,D_C,D_O,D_T) has a declared scale, estimand, or admissible-transformation class -- the same weighted-sum construction the corpus has rejected elsewhere (step-025c-1's scoring rejection, step-019's partial-order-with-Incomparable insistence, step-003's scalar-as-projection doctrine).

rows.anchor: §206.18 does raise the alarm ... we must not pretend that d_sem = 0.73 is scientifically meaningful ... But the caught defect is false precision, not scale admissibility. Even a fully validated measurement procedure would not make a weighted sum legitimate
rows.statement: Notes a partial self-catch in step-206: it correctly separates formal construct / operational measure / empirical validation and admits only the first exists, but this self-catch addresses false numerical precision, not the deeper measurement-theoretic defect that a weighted sum over unscaled components is illegitimate even once validated -- 'the self-catch is one level short'.

rows.anchor: The file contains no experiments at all ... issues four boxed PASS verdicts ... plus a Gītā CONSISTENT. Classification: PROCESS-STATUS-ONLY ×5. This is the first file in the corpus to issue a multi-dimensional PASS with a zero-test denominator
rows.statement: Step-206 is identified as the first file in the corpus to issue multi-dimensional PASS verdicts (DDD/Mathematics/Statistics/Governance plus a Gita CONSISTENT) with zero experiments, even narrated ones, present in the file at all; step-207 (this file's second subject) repeats the pattern with six boxed PASS verdicts and zero experiments, the second consecutive such file.

rows.anchor: we should never write: 'KnowledgeOS is Krishna.' That would collapse metaphor and architecture ... honours step-156A's lens rule, and is a marked improvement on the erosion observed at steps 158/140338
rows.statement: Step-206 is rated Gita-lens-discipline COMPLIANT and exemplary for explicitly stating the anti-collapse guard ('we should never write: KnowledgeOS is Krishna') and following the chain philosophical-analogy->architectural-question->formal-model, marked as an improvement over lens-discipline erosion the verification programme had previously observed at steps 158 and 140338.

rows.anchor: §207.30 minimality/sufficiency: ILL-TYPED. Information(·) is used as a measure ... and is never defined ... Contract = Minimal sufficient semantic projection ... not evaluable — an optimisation target over an undefined measure
rows.statement: Step-207's minimality/sufficiency claim (Contract = Minimal sufficient semantic projection, objective 'minimize coupling subject to semantic sufficiency') is ruled ILL-TYPED: Information(.) is used as a measure over contracts/contexts without ever being defined (Shannon? field count? transitive-closure cardinality?) and the ordering '<<' is not a defined relation, making the stated optimization target unevaluable.

rows.anchor: §207.5–207.6 version-pinning ... re-derivation of step-058 ... uncited ... §207.16 ExecutionResult ≠ Outcome ... re-derives step-064 ... §207.25 ... re-derives step-053's SchemaCompatibility ≠ SemanticCompatibility ... §207.43 ... re-derives step-016 T10, step-022 H1/H2, step-048 I3 and step-055 ... §207.36–37 AI_can(x) ⇏ AI_may(x) ... re-derives step-062, step-065, step-053
rows.statement: Step-207's five derivation-VALID results are each independently identified as uncited re-derivations of earlier corpus steps (version pinning from step-058/055, ExecutionResult!=Outcome from step-064, schema-vs-semantic compatibility from step-053, historical-validity-at-applicable-time from steps 016/022/048/055, and AI_can(x) not-implies AI_may(x) from steps 062/065/053) -- correct as mathematics, but none crediting its source, extending the corpus-wide re-derivation-without-citation pattern.

rows.anchor: I_C (§207.39): a new named invariant, unnumbered, outside step-048's frozen 𝓘 — extending TV-F-029 to the corpus head (now ≥26 such invariants)
rows.statement: Step-207's contract invariant I_C=Identity∧Version∧SemanticIntegrity∧Provenance∧TemporalValidity is a new named invariant minted outside step-048's frozen invariant set 𝓘 with no number assigned, extending the previously-registered finding TV-F-029 (unnumbered invariant sprawl) to the corpus head, now counted at 26 or more such invariants.

rows.anchor: Step-206 proposes seven candidate contexts: Observation, Evidence, Assessment, Model, Governance, Decision, Execution. Step-052 proposed seven: Evidence, Semantic, Knowledge, Causal, Decision, Governance, Learning ... UNRESOLVED / NO SUPERSESSION EVIDENCE ... Register sync: AC C-084
rows.statement: TV-F-040: step-206 derives a second seven-bounded-context map (Observation/Evidence/Assessment/Model/Governance/Decision/Execution) that shares only 3 of 7 contexts with an earlier map at step-052 (Evidence/Semantic/Knowledge/Causal/Decision/Governance/Learning); step-052 is never cited, no supersession is claimed or evidenced, and step-207 builds its entire contract algebra on the newer, unreconciled map alone -- classified UNRESOLVED/NO SUPERSESSION EVIDENCE, severity MAJOR for the DDD track, registered as AC C-084.

rows.anchor: Step 208's headline question is already answered three times in the corpus ... LocalCorrectness ⇏ GlobalCorrectness ... CorrectContexts ⇏ CorrectComposition ... Attack 50 exhibits a concrete instance ... Register sync: AC C-085
rows.statement: TV-F-041: step-207's forward-announced Step 208 (Semantic Contract Algebra) is scoped around a question ('can a chain of individually valid transformations produce an invalid conclusion') already answered affirmatively three times in the corpus (step-048 LocalCorrectness!=GlobalCorrectness, step-058 CorrectContexts!=CorrectComposition, and step-050 Attack 50's concrete counterexample), none of which step-207 cites; the corpus's positive composition claim (step-053's LocalInvariant+ContractInvariant=>GlobalInvariant, with undefined operators oplus/Preserve) stands contradicted by Attack 50 (TV-F-039). Registered as AC C-085; recommends Step 208 instead define the composition operator oplus and Preserve(T_ij,I), the two symbols left undefined since step-048/step-053, rather than re-establishing an already-known result.

rows.anchor: Survivor candidates from these two steps ... Not survivors: the boundary score B(i,j) and d_sem (scale unestablished); Contract = Minimal sufficient semantic projection (measure undefined)
rows.statement: Summary verdict table for steps 206-207: survivor candidates are Decision_Epistemic!=Decision_Governance!=Decision_Operational, Actor-knowledge subset System-memory subset Reality, the typed-arrow discipline plus KnowledgeGraph!=KnowledgeOS, and version-pinned assessment references; explicitly non-surviving are the boundary score B(i,j)/d_sem (scale unestablished) and 'Contract = Minimal sufficient semantic projection' (measure undefined).

rows.anchor: Chronology is evidence of evolution, but chronology is NOT evidence of correctness or supersession
rows.statement: States the mandate's foundational principle for the verification session: chronology in the corpus is evidence of evolution but never evidence of correctness or supersession; the evolution must be reconstructed and verified explicitly rather than assumed from document order.

rows.anchor: Senior Mathematician ... Senior Statistician ... Senior Measurement-Theory Expert ... Senior Knowledge Engineer ... Senior DDD Architect ... Senior Software/Systems Architect ... Independent Scientific Reviewer ... Your job is not to defend the KnowledgeOS theory
rows.statement: Instructs the verifier to work simultaneously as seven expert roles (mathematician, statistician, measurement-theory expert, knowledge engineer, DDD architect, software/systems architect, independent scientific reviewer), explicitly not to defend the theory, and not to reward elegance, later terminology, or self-applied labels (PASS/RATIFIED/TESTED/SOUND/CONFORMANT) as mathematical proof.

rows.anchor: Complete the verification of every theory-bearing step ... Do not sample ... If a numbered step does not exist, record: NON-EXISTENT / NO SOURCE FOUND
rows.statement: Requires exhaustive (non-sampled) verification of every theory-bearing step from 001 through the final numbered steps, with a specific NON-EXISTENT/NO SOURCE FOUND label for a forward-referenced but missing step number, and preservation of internal steps when a document contains multiple.

rows.anchor: Problem → Idea → Definition → Assumptions → Derivation → Result → Computability → Test → Later response → Current status ... Do not collapse these categories
rows.statement: Defines the per-step audit chain Problem->Idea->Definition->Assumptions->Derivation->Result->Computability->Test->Later response->Current status, with an explicit instruction never to collapse these categories together.

rows.anchor: 1. Is it syntactically meaningful? ... 10. Can an example be instantiated?
rows.statement: Defines a ten-point definition audit for every mathematical/domain object: syntactic meaningfulness, semantic unambiguity, clear type, known domain, known codomain, existence, uniqueness, constructibility, computability, instantiability.

rows.anchor: PROVEN ... CONDITIONALLY PROVEN ... DERIVED-CONDITIONAL ... CONJECTURE ... HYPOTHESIS ... NOT ESTABLISHED ... REFUTED ... CONTRADICTED ... Identify the first invalid inference if the derivation fails
rows.statement: Defines an eight-value derivation-status classification (PROVEN, CONDITIONALLY PROVEN, DERIVED-CONDITIONAL, CONJECTURE, HYPOTHESIS, NOT ESTABLISHED, REFUTED, CONTRADICTED) and requires locating the first invalid inference when a derivation fails, rejecting prose connectives ('therefore', 'hence', 'obviously', 'by definition') as unchecked justification.

rows.anchor: DEFINED ONLY ... INPUTS NOT KNOWN ... CONSTRUCTIBLE ... COMPUTABLE ... COMPUTABLE UNDER RESTRICTIONS ... TESTABLE ... NOT COMPUTABLE AS CLAIMED ... UNDECIDABLE IN GENERAL ... NOT REALIZED ... A formula is not automatically an algorithm
rows.statement: Defines a nine-rung computability-classification ladder (DEFINED ONLY, INPUTS NOT KNOWN, CONSTRUCTIBLE, COMPUTABLE, COMPUTABLE UNDER RESTRICTIONS, TESTABLE, NOT COMPUTABLE AS CLAIMED, UNDECIDABLE IN GENERAL, NOT REALIZED), with the principle that a formula is not automatically an algorithm and an algorithm is not automatically executable on actual KnowledgeOS data.

rows.anchor: probability space ... random variables ... estimand ... estimator ... sampling frame ... assumptions ... independence/dependence ... calibration ... scale ... uncertainty propagation ... missingness ... model uncertainty ... causal assumptions
rows.statement: Defines a statistical-validity checklist (probability space, random variables, estimand, estimator, sampling frame, assumptions, independence/dependence, calibration, scale, uncertainty propagation, missingness, model uncertainty, causal assumptions) to be applied wherever probability, uncertainty, confidence, evidence strength, likelihood, entropy, estimation or aggregation appears, warning never to assume a familiar-looking formula is valid.

rows.anchor: construct ... operational definition ... estimand ... measurement scale ... admissible transformations ... aggregation legitimacy ... calibration ... interpretation ... verify whether arithmetic such as means, differences or thresholds is legitimate for the stated scale
rows.statement: Defines a measurement-theory checklist (construct, operational definition, estimand, measurement scale, admissible transformations, aggregation legitimacy, calibration, interpretation) for every metric/score/distance/index, specifically requiring a check of whether means/differences/thresholds are legitimate arithmetic for the stated scale.

rows.anchor: ACTUALLY_EXECUTED ... EXECUTED_PARTIAL ... REPRODUCIBLE_WITNESS ... VERIFIER-CONSTRUCTED ... CORPUS-INTERNAL-COUNTEREXAMPLE ... CONCEPTUAL-ONLY ... PROCESS-STATUS-ONLY ... NOT_EXECUTED
rows.statement: Defines an eight-value empirical-evidence classification for every 'test'/'experiment'/'PASS'/'validation' claim (ACTUALLY_EXECUTED, EXECUTED_PARTIAL, REPRODUCIBLE_WITNESS, VERIFIER-CONSTRUCTED, CORPUS-INTERNAL-COUNTEREXAMPLE, CONCEPTUAL-ONLY, PROCESS-STATUS-ONLY, NOT_EXECUTED), requiring both what the experiment establishes and what it explicitly does not establish to be recorded.

rows.anchor: Knowledge; Knowledge State; System State; Evidence; Observation; Assertion; Assessment; Claim; Proposition; Determination; Truth; Belief; Confidence; Probability; Uncertainty; Unknown; Underdetermined; Conflict; Zero; State; Event; Command; Operation; Transition; Phase; Policy; Authority; Provenance; Lineage; Kernel; Decision; Action; Outcome ... Do not silently resolve terminology conflicts
rows.statement: Specifies a named list of ~33 terms (Knowledge, Knowledge State, System State, Evidence, Observation, Assertion, Assessment, Claim, Proposition, Determination, Truth, Belief, Confidence, Probability, Uncertainty, Unknown, Underdetermined, Conflict, Zero, State, Event, Command, Operation, Transition, Phase, Policy, Authority, Provenance, Lineage, Kernel, Decision, Action, Outcome) requiring per-step DDD/UL auditing for meaning drift, synonym use, and overloading, with an explicit instruction never to silently resolve terminology conflicts.

rows.anchor: RESOLVED ... PARTIALLY_RESOLVED ... REFRAMED ... UNRESOLVED ... CONTRADICTED ... SUPERSEDED_WITH_EVIDENCE ... APPARENTLY_RESOLVED_BUT_NOT_PROVEN ... Addressed is not equivalent to answered
rows.statement: Defines a seven-value question-answer-evolution status (RESOLVED, PARTIALLY_RESOLVED, REFRAMED, UNRESOLVED, CONTRADICTED, SUPERSEDED_WITH_EVIDENCE, APPARENTLY_RESOLVED_BUT_NOT_PROVEN) for every question raised in an older document, with the stated principle that a later document merely mentioning the same subject does not resolve the earlier question ('addressed is not equivalent to answered').

rows.anchor: A later document supersedes an earlier formulation only if there is evidence such as: explicit replacement ... Otherwise preserve both formulations and mark the relationship unresolved ... particularly important for: Q13/Q14/Q15/Q20; Step 201–205; the 025-series; invariant registries; K_t; S_t; Zero; transition functions; kernel definitions; Assessment vs Assertion
rows.statement: States the anti-date-inference rule: a later formulation supersedes an earlier one only given explicit evidence (replacement, rejection, correction, revised-definition statement, withdrawal, authority statement, or a demonstrable derivation the earlier formulation cannot survive); otherwise both formulations must be preserved and the relationship marked unresolved -- flagged as particularly important for Q13-Q20, Steps 201-205, the 025-series, invariant registries, K_t, S_t, Zero, transition functions, kernel definitions, and the Assertion-vs-Assessment split.

rows.anchor: If the corpus contains K_t = A and later K_t = B, do not simply choose B ... The output may legitimately be: NO CANONICAL FORM ESTABLISHED. That is a valid verification result
rows.statement: States the anti-forced-canonicalization rule: when two definitions of the same symbol (e.g. K_t=A then K_t=B) appear, the verifier must not simply adopt the later one but must establish whether A was explicitly rejected, whether B truly replaces A, whether they mean different things, whether a mapping exists, or whether both apply at different abstraction levels; 'NO CANONICAL FORM ESTABLISHED' is stated to be a valid, legitimate verification result.

rows.anchor: TRACK A — VERIFICATION ... TRACK B — RECONSTRUCTION ... TRACK C — DOCUMENTATION ... Do not allow Track B or Track C to contaminate Track A ... VERIFIER RECOMMENDATION — NOT ESTABLISHED BY CORPUS
rows.statement: Defines three separated tracks to be maintained throughout: Track A Verification (what the corpus mathematically establishes), Track B Reconstruction (what a coherent surviving theory could be built from verified survivors), Track C Documentation (how the final theory should eventually be presented), with an explicit rule that B and C must never contaminate A -- any proposed repair to a broken definition must be labelled 'VERIFIER RECOMMENDATION — NOT ESTABLISHED BY CORPUS' rather than silently substituted.

rows.anchor: introduced → questioned → modified → criticized → replaced/refined → mathematically verified/refuted → surviving interpretation ... at least: Knowledge; Evidence; Identity; Observation; ... K_t; S_t; State; Event; Transition; Replay; Invariants; Kernel; Aggregation; Normalization; Determination; Decision; Policy; Governance; DDD boundaries; Measurement/SNF
rows.statement: Requires a genuine evolutionary graph per concept (introduced->questioned->modified->criticized->replaced/refined->mathematically verified/refuted->surviving interpretation) for at least 24 named concepts including Knowledge, Evidence, Identity, K_t, S_t, State, Transition, Replay, Invariants, Kernel, Aggregation, Normalization, Determination, Decision, Policy, Governance, DDD boundaries, and Measurement/SNF.

rows.anchor: Step | Source | Problem | Main idea | New definition | Derivation | Computability | Test | Later response | Current verdict | UL verdict | Final-theory destination ... Every step must have a row
rows.statement: Requires a final master 210+-row table (one row per numbered step) with columns Step/Source/Problem/Main idea/New definition/Derivation/Computability/Test/Later response/Current verdict/UL verdict/Final-theory destination, forbidding hidden gaps in prose and requiring separate listing when several documents claim the same step number.

rows.anchor: The existing artifacts are inputs to verification, not authorities ... Treat all previous classifications as provisional verifier hypotheses. Do not preserve an earlier finding merely for consistency ... A1 Theory Inventory ... AC Contradiction Register ... TV-F-001 onward ... K0 ... V2 ... V3 ... STEP-TRACEABILITY-REGISTER ... all B1–B7 traces
rows.statement: Requires rechecking a named list of prior verification artifacts (A1-A9, AM, AC Contradiction Register, TV-F-001 onward, K0, V2, V3, STEP-TRACEABILITY-REGISTER, B1-B7 traces) as provisional verifier hypotheses rather than authorities, with an explicit instruction to correct and record when a previous finding is wrong rather than preserving it for consistency.

rows.anchor: observational impossibility ... identifiability/factorization ... Zero termination ... evidence-inertness/no-skip ... three-valued conjunction ... raw aggregation impossibility ... normalization requirements ... signed monotonicity ... scalar conflict-retention result ... replay determinism ... decidability claims ... 2^n bound ... invariant satisfiability ... genesis-blindness ... D-S counterexamples
rows.statement: Names fifteen specific already-PROVEN corpus theorems/propositions to be independently rechecked (hypotheses, definitions, domain, codomain, logical inference, hidden assumptions, conclusion, counterexamples to weaker formulations), including observational impossibility, identifiability/factorization, Zero termination, evidence-inertness/no-skip, three-valued conjunction, raw aggregation impossibility, signed monotonicity, replay determinism, the 2^n bound, invariant satisfiability, genesis-blindness, and D-S counterexamples -- with the caution neither to downgrade a theorem for difficult application nor to upgrade an application merely because its underlying theorem is correct.

rows.anchor: Do not count: code existing ... test files existing ... 'PASS' written in a document ... conceptual experiment descriptions ... as executed evidence. Where execution is possible, execute it
rows.statement: States that the mere existence of code, test files, a written 'PASS', or a conceptual experiment description must never be counted as executed evidence; where execution is possible it must actually be executed, and the chain Claim->Required computation->Existing implementation->Execution evidence->Result->Scope must be maintained.

rows.anchor: KI-ID ... satisfiability status ... whether it is definitional, epistemic, governance, architectural or empirical ... Does the intended interpretation of the consolidated invariant system have at least one model? ... Do not confuse: there exists a model under arbitrary interpretations with: the intended KnowledgeOS semantics are jointly satisfiable
rows.statement: Requires a fresh KI-ID invariant catalogue (source, exact statement, semantic meaning, duplicate group, layer, MUST/SHOULD status, assumptions, logical dependencies, satisfiability status, definitional/epistemic/governance/architectural/empirical classification) and draws a sharp distinction between a model existing under arbitrary interpretations versus the intended KnowledgeOS semantics being jointly satisfiable -- these are stated to be different claims not to be confused.

rows.anchor: Assertion ↔ Assessment schism ... Unknown ↔ Underdetermined ↔ Inconclusive ↔ Unobserved ↔ NotApplicable ↔ Withheld ... Conflict ↔ Escalation ↔ Decision Blocking ... Knowledge ↔ Knowledge State ↔ Knowledge Artifact
rows.statement: Requires UL to be treated as a mathematical dependency rather than documentation cleanup, and specifically flags four term-cluster investigations: the Assertion<->Assessment schism, the Unknown<->Underdetermined<->Inconclusive<->Unobserved<->NotApplicable<->Withheld cluster, Conflict<->Escalation<->Decision Blocking, and Knowledge<->Knowledge State<->Knowledge Artifact.

rows.anchor: the current verification records indicate that 'Phase' itself may never have been formally defined. Verify this directly ... Do not invent a definition
rows.statement: Requires directly verifying whether 'Phase' (the corpus directory's own namesake, phase_measure_theory) is a mere folder/history label, an epistemic concept, a lifecycle concept, a mathematical state, a DDD concept, or an undefined term, with an explicit prohibition on inventing a definition if none is found.

rows.anchor: SURVIVOR THEORY ... Source → Verified statement → Dependencies → Proof status → Computability → Test evidence → DDD meaning → Architecture consequence ... REFUTED; CONTRADICTED; UNVERIFIED; CONDITIONAL; PROPOSED RECONSTRUCTION; OPEN QUESTION
rows.statement: Requires a final survivor test producing a Survivor Theory register (per concept: Source->Verified statement->Dependencies->Proof status->Computability->Test evidence->DDD meaning->Architecture consequence) containing only propositions that survived verification, with everything else routed to REFUTED/CONTRADICTED/UNVERIFIED/CONDITIONAL/PROPOSED RECONSTRUCTION/OPEN QUESTION.

rows.anchor: Do NOT yet produce the polished book-style final KnowledgeOS theory ... that document must be downstream of this verification. Do not write it prematurely
rows.statement: Explicitly forbids writing the polished final 'KNOWLEDGEOS — VERIFIED THEORY AND MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATION' document prematurely; it must be downstream of the verification substrate this phase produces.

rows.anchor: UNVERIFIABLE — BLOCKED BY <specific missing object/evidence> ... Do not fill the gap by assumption
rows.statement: Defines a stop-condition rule set: completion requires an explicit historical/epistemic record per step, a traceable answer-status per major question, mathematical-dependency checks, computability assessment, and separated/audited UL -- not merely the existence of registers or a count of proven propositions; unverifiable items must be labelled 'UNVERIFIABLE — BLOCKED BY <specific missing object/evidence>' rather than filled by assumption.

rows.anchor: How much of the theory actually survives independent verification, how the surviving theory evolved from the original 210+ steps, and exactly where the boundary lies between established mathematics, conditional mathematics, empirical evidence, domain modelling, architecture, design choice and unresolved research. That boundary is the principal deliverable
rows.statement: States the governing principle of the whole verification phase: the purpose is not to prove the theory correct but to locate, with maximum honesty, the boundary between established mathematics, conditional mathematics, empirical evidence, domain modelling, architecture, design choice, and unresolved research -- that boundary itself is named as the phase's principal deliverable.

rows.anchor: the minimum cited step number in the entire 16-file scope is 66
rows.statement: Batch-level finding: no file among steps 067-082 cites any step below 66, meaning every overlap with steps 009-037 is an uncited re-derivation; the corpus behaves as a sliding 1-3-step memory window.

rows.anchor: 0 of 7 [invariants] pass ... I_TypePreservation and I_1 are the same proposition minted twice
rows.statement: Step-067 (Epistemic Type System) mints 14 epistemic types and 7 invariant names, none of which state a decidable predicate; I_TypePreservation and I_1 duplicate one proposition under two names; re-derives steps 010/018's typed inference apparatus uncited, without step-018's truth-value algebra.

rows.anchor: FIRST INVALID INFERENCE — §68.10 ... circular ... step-068 SILENTLY RE-DERIVES step-009
rows.statement: Step-068 (contradiction/paraconsistency) is ruled INVALID: its explosion-test claims 'NotDerivable' for an arbitrary q with no consequence relation ever specified (circular); it silently re-derives step-009's four-valued lattice with net information loss, dropping step-009's AGM-insufficiency critique and its Priest/LP naming.

rows.anchor: §69.6 ... false back-reference ... I_Causal ... first minted in step-074 ... five steps later
rows.statement: Step-069 (computability/state-space) falsely back-references five invariants (I_Type, I_Provenance, I_Causal, I_Authorization, I_Conflict) as previously established; four were never minted anywhere in scope and the fifth is minted five steps later (VF-1), undermining the sole justification for its state-transition error rule; otherwise rated the batch's strongest derivation (finite representation implies computability, under an undischarged decidable-invariant assumption).

rows.anchor: THE 8 BOXED FAILs ... Element S (State) never receives a FAIL ... Two incompatible 'minimal kernels' are boxed within 20 lines
rows.statement: Step-070's minimal-kernel removal-test experiment (8 elements A,T,P,E,I,S,X,R) produces FAIL for only 7, two of those circular, and State receives 'PASS WITH PERFORMANCE FAILURE' rather than FAIL; the file nonetheless boxes an 8-element minimal kernel and, 20 lines later, a 7-element K_L excluding State, with three distinct senses of 'kernel' used interchangeably (VF-2).

rows.anchor: §70.34's composition law ... Ordering ≠ Causality (Lamport clocks correctly characterized)
rows.statement: Step-070's transformation composition law (Post(X1)=>Pre(X2)) and its correct Lamport-clock ordering-vs-causality distinction are validated; the kernel loop Input->Classify->Validate->Transform->CheckInvariants->Commit->ProjectState is rated the single most implementation-ready artifact in the batch.

rows.anchor: VF-5 ... §71.59 then boxes SemanticBoundary + InvariantBoundary + OwnershipBoundary + FailureBoundary — substituting an undefined ... OwnershipBoundary for BoundedContext
rows.statement: Step-071 (compositional correctness) gives a valid inductive-invariant argument, honestly qualified as proving specification-preservation not real-world correctness, but silently substitutes an undefined 'OwnershipBoundary' for 'BoundedContext' in its four-boundary alignment claim (VF-5), and its C_global 5-conjunct correctness definition rests on an undefined meaning-equivalence relation.

rows.anchor: Exp 7 ... 'The semantics differ too much' is not a derivation ... M(S_A,S_B) ... no total function
rows.statement: Step-072 (concurrency) defines a genuinely checkable commutativity condition and optimistic-concurrency version check, but its three FAIL verdicts all assert undesirability rather than demonstrate breakage, and its semantic merge operator M is defined only on two disjoint cases with no total function covering the mixed case.

rows.anchor: Reliability(A,C) ... the only fully-specified numeric estimator ... the file's headline equation is a NOT_DEFINED aggregate
rows.statement: Step-073 (identity/trust/provenance) correctly specifies cryptographic signing/hashing/Merkle constructions and the only fully-specified numeric estimator in the batch (Reliability=correct/evaluated), but its headline result 'Trustworthy provenance = Identity+Authenticity+Integrity+EpistemicProvenance+Context+Authority' aggregates undefined quantities (Trust, TrustAssessment) via an undefined '+'; amends the kernel (adding Identity, dropping State) with no supersession record against step-070 (VF-3).

rows.anchor: Weakest inference — §74.20 ... No such pair (M_1, M_2) is exhibited
rows.statement: Step-074 (causal knowledge) imports textbook-correct SCM/do-calculus/potential-outcomes definitions (unattributed to steps 014/025P) but its central non-identifiability claim is never instantiated with an actual counterexample pair of causal models.

rows.anchor: Arithmetic check, §75.3 ... Verified correct ... EU maximization presupposes the von Neumann–Morgenstern axioms; none is stated
rows.statement: Step-075 (decision theory) re-derives expected-utility/EVPI machinery already built in steps 015/021/025H with zero citation, introducing only the weaker EVPI (not EVSI); its one worked arithmetic example is correct, but its scalar-utility framework is left undermined by an unstated von Neumann-Morgenstern assumption that its own later vector-utility revision (step-076) retroactively invalidates.

rows.anchor: The only file in scope earning an unqualified VALID ... Pareto dominance ... mathematically correct
rows.statement: Step-076 (multi-objective decisions) is the only file in the 16-file scope to earn an unqualified VALID derivation verdict: Pareto dominance/frontier and weighted scalarization are correctly stated and worked examples verified componentwise; re-derives Pareto optimality from steps 015/021/025H uncited but is otherwise rated the strongest and most computable file in the batch.

rows.anchor: FIRST INVALID INFERENCE — §77.8 ... subtracts two elements of Decision ... §77.8 and §79.3 are in direct tension
rows.statement: Step-077 (governance of the decision model) asserts a decision-change decomposes additively (DecisionDiff=KnowledgeDiff+ModelDiff+PolicyDiff+ContextDiff) by subtracting elements of an algebraically structureless Decision type; this additive-separability assumption is directly contradicted by step-079's later proof of non-separability (VF-8), and its own I_HistoricalDecision duplicates step-075's I_DecisionPolicy (VF-7); rated strongest DDD content in the batch for jointly proposing and bounding a Governance context.

rows.anchor: three Agent tuples, three arities ... CONTRADICTORY
rows.statement: Step-078 (multi-agent boundary) defines three incompatible Agent tuples across two files (7-field, 5-field, 6-field, with State/Beliefs/Goals/role added and dropped inconsistently); contains no adversarial-agent model at all despite step-037 having already built one, a regression rather than an omission; its universal-voting FAIL experiment is asserted rather than demonstrated.

rows.anchor: IS THE ALGEBRA DEFINED OR NOTATED? — NOTATED ... the single numeric instantiation of the algebra is inconsistent with its own notation
rows.statement: Step-079's local/global invariant algebra and utility-interaction-term algebra (I_ij) are ruled NOTATED not DEFINED: the index set is unspecified, and the file's sole worked numeric example (100+100-250=-50) is arithmetically inconsistent with its own written summation convention (VF-9); also asserts distributed optimization (§79.54) directly after proving the same objective is non-separable (VF-12).

rows.anchor: THE ONE GENUINELY FORMAL INVARIANT IN THE BATCH — §80.53 ... I_Dependency ... A number does not become mathematically meaningful merely because it is precise
rows.statement: Step-080 (organizational control) contains I_Dependency, the only well-formed decidable invariant predicate among all 64 minted names in the 16-file scope, derived via an explicit ArchitecturePrinciple->FormalInvariant->ExecutableCheck pipeline; also contains the batch's clearest self-discipline, explicitly refusing to fabricate an aggregate drift metric ('a number does not become mathematically meaningful merely because it is precise') while nonetheless building a full control-loop apparatus (thresholds, hysteresis, velocity/acceleration) on that undefined metric.

rows.anchor: SAME NOTION, RE-MINTED WITH A CHANGED SUBSCRIPT ... net: notational churn plus a partial regression
rows.statement: Step-081 (observability/identifiability) re-derives step-026's observational-equivalence and identifiability definitions verbatim in substance (only the subscript and carrier symbol change) without citation; its new True/False/Unknown/NotApplicable governance-status codomain is weaker than step-009's four-valued lattice (VF-4); re-mints I_EvidenceIndependence under an altered, narrower scope than step-071's original (VF-6); its decision-relevant-observability weakening of the observability requirement is a genuine, validly-argued contribution.

rows.anchor: PER-COMPONENT RULES, NOT A CALCULUS ... FIRST INVALID INFERENCE — §82.44 ... direct internal contradiction
rows.statement: Step-082 (uncertainty propagation) correctly states a full set of standard propagation rules (delta method, variance addition, Bayes, Monte Carlo) with all worked arithmetic verified correct, but is ruled a rule-list not a calculus (no closure, no composition across rule types); directly contradicts its own proof that standard deviations are not additive by writing Uncertainty(D)=U_1+U_2+... 37 sections later (VF-11), and boxes a uniform propagation chain despite having proven the representation is not closed under its own transformations (VF-13); re-derives step-011 (near-identical title) and a third independent derivation of the same covariance identity (after steps 071/082 itself).

rows.anchor: VF-14 ... a 100% expectation-confirmation rate is itself evidence that no test was run
rows.statement: Registers VF-14: across all 16 files and ~350 boxed PASS/FAIL verdicts, not one records a divergence between its own stated Expected and its Result, which for a document series presenting itself as adversarial testing is itself evidence that no test was actually executed.

rows.anchor: Highest-value artifacts in scope: 080 §80.53's I_Dependency ... 076's Pareto treatment ... 081 §81.35–81.37's DecisionRelevantObservability
rows.statement: Summary determination for steps 067-082: highest-value surviving artifacts are I_Dependency (the one executable invariant), two explicit refusals to fabricate an aggregate metric (080, 081), step-076's unqualified-VALID Pareto treatment, step-073's 'authenticity is orthogonal to truth', step-071's honest correctness-vs-reality qualification, and step-081's decision-relevant-observability weakening.

rows.anchor: A 636-experiment suite with a 100% pass rate and no negative control is not evidence of correctness
rows.statement: Standing finding for steps 083-100: every experiment is a stipulated Expected followed by a boxed PASS matching it, with FAIL appearing 0 times as a genuine verdict across 18 files (two FAIL strings are dashboard illustrations); a 636-experiment 100% pass rate with no negative control is evidence the suite cannot fail, not evidence of correctness.

rows.anchor: D=(DecisionContent,...) ... §83.68 ... not the same object and are never reconciled ... TrueAt/KnownAt
rows.statement: Step-083 (temporal reasoning) mints two incompatible Decision tuples in the same file, indexes everything by time via TrueAt/KnownAt with no satisfaction relation ever given, and silently re-derives step-016's five-time/bitemporal model uncited while re-minting I_TemporalTruth (already minted at step-066).

rows.anchor: I_Intervention is a third minting ... §84.13 concedes NotIdentifiable then boxes PASS anyway
rows.statement: Step-084 (counterfactuals) correctly imports textbook SCM/do-calculus/potential-outcomes but re-derives it from zero without citing steps 014/025P/074, mints I_Intervention as a third instance of an existing invariant name (after steps 063 and 074), and boxes PASS on an experiment its own text concedes is NotIdentifiable.

rows.anchor: Nash equilibrium is correctly and completely defined ... §85.27–85.28 immediately show the adversary adapts to the composite too, which refutes the claim it just made
rows.statement: Step-085 (game theory) correctly and completely defines Nash equilibrium (the only fully formal object in the file) but re-derives source-incentive/trust material from steps 019/037 uncited, and its central claim that a composite threshold metric resists gaming is directly refuted by its own next section, which shows the adversary adapts to the composite too -- both scored PASS.

rows.anchor: A^{feasible} ... the single best-formed construct in the entire 18-file scope ... no impossibility theorem is invoked or cited
rows.statement: Step-086 (mechanism design) produces A^feasible, rated the single best-formed construct in the 18-file scope (a decidable-predicate set-builder, contingent on invariants that are never themselves decidable); asserts a 100%-fairness/efficiency/incentive-compatibility impossibility without invoking the relevant named theorems (Gibbard-Satterthwaite/Myerson-Satterthwaite).

rows.anchor: does not generate the Condorcet cycle claimed ... The boxed PASS certifies a false worked example
rows.statement: Step-087 (collective choice) mints 8 invariants including I_Delegation (a second minting after step-078) and its central worked example does not actually produce the Condorcet cycle it claims (2 of 3 voters share an ordering, so no cycle results), certifying a mathematically false example as PASS; correctly notes Arrow's conditions without stating the theorem.

rows.anchor: A statistic T(X) is sufficient ... Formally, through the factorization criterion ... every subsequent use of 'sufficiency' is a different, undefined notion
rows.statement: Step-088 (information theory/compression) correctly states the Fisher-Neyman factorization criterion for statistical sufficiency exactly once, then uses 'sufficiency' in four further undefined senses (decision-sufficient, K_sufficient, etc.) with no argument connecting them to the formal definition; I_NegativeKnowledge is a normative gloss strictly weaker than the correct modal-logic fact stated one section earlier.

rows.anchor: the strongest definitional file in scope ... §89.6 Experiment 4 ... does not follow when rules are mutually referential
rows.statement: Step-089 (computability/decidability) is rated the strongest definitional file in the 18-file scope (decidability, halting problem, safety/liveness in temporal-logic form all correctly and completely stated); its inference from per-rule termination to decidability of the whole rule set is invalid when rules are mutually referential, which the file itself later assumes may occur.

rows.anchor: COMPLEXITY/COST CLAIMS ASSERTED WITHOUT ARGUMENT ... A 10,000× speedup asserted with no model
rows.statement: Step-090 (complexity/economics) is dominated by seven unargued quantitative claims (a 10,000x incremental-computation speedup, an off-by-2x pairwise count, an Amdahl's-law-free parallelism claim, stipulated VOI figures, a stipulated 100x cost-reduction, a stipulated 20-year runtime), against one genuinely correct threshold-vs-confidence-interval argument; is substantially duplicated by step-098 without citation.

rows.anchor: I_Composition as stated is false as a general rule ... The file states the rule, then gives a counterexample to it, then boxes both PASS
rows.statement: Step-091 (formal specification/refinement) correctly states abstraction functions, refinement, Hoare triples and trace containment (second-strongest definitional file), but its compositional-correctness invariant is false as stated absent a non-interference side condition that the file's own very next experiment demonstrates is necessary -- both the rule and its counterexample are boxed PASS.

rows.anchor: the PASS is syntactically attached to the negative branch, so the experiment records PASS whether or not the policy is declared
rows.statement: Step-092 (concurrency) correctly states serializability, idempotency and an authority-uniqueness cardinality bound, but contains an experiment whose boxed PASS is grammatically attached to the negative branch of its own conditional, so it cannot discriminate any outcome; silently re-derives step-072's epistemic-vs-distributed-consistency result and re-mints three of its invariant names (I_Concurrency, I_Conflict, I_Version) uncited.

rows.anchor: 'Strongest' presupposes a total order on evidence strength that has never been constructed anywhere in Steps 083–100
rows.statement: Step-093 (reliability/recovery) correctly formalizes event-sourcing Fold and idempotency (re-derived from steps 083/092 uncited) but its recovery-invariant reasoning invokes a total order on evidence strength ('strongest trustworthy evidence') that is never constructed anywhere in the 083-100 range; proposes fault injection/chaos testing as the correct method and then does not perform it.

rows.anchor: This is a silent regression presented as a new PASS ... a bare h=H(X) with no chaining at all, which is weaker than what 022 already had
rows.statement: Step-094 (security/adversarial trust) re-derives Integrity!=Truth and Authenticity!=Authority!=Reliability (already established at step-022) with a strictly weaker unchained hash primitive than step-022's hash-chain machinery -- a silent regression presented as new; its composite I_Security invariant conjoins four sub-invariants (I_Authentication, I_Authorization, I_Integrity, I_Privilege) that are never defined anywhere in steps 083-100, yet is later treated as evaluable by steps 099 and 100.

rows.anchor: the only file in scope containing a fully formal, correctly stated, quantitative privacy definition ... none of the 12 invariants uses either
rows.statement: Step-095 (privacy/information boundaries) is the only file in the 18-file scope with a fully formal quantitative definition (epsilon-differential-privacy and its composition rule, plus a correct confidentiality partial order), yet none of its 12 minted invariants actually references either formal object; its automated-test experiment (10,000 unauthorized access attempts) has no harness and its own caveat about evidence-not-proof does not affect the recorded PASS verdict.

rows.anchor: I_MigrationIntegrity is the sharpest ... the only invariant in scope with an obvious mechanical test ... extends 092's 𝒦=(S,A,T,I,O) to a 7-tuple 𝒦_t — an unannounced signature change
rows.statement: Step-096 (learning/adaptation) mints I_MigrationIntegrity, rated the single invariant in the 083-100 scope with an obvious mechanical test against a migration script; silently changes the corpus's kernel-state tuple signature from 092's 5-tuple K=(S,A,T,I,O) to a 7-tuple K_t dropping Observations and adding three new fields, with no mapping given between the two.

rows.anchor: cites no prior step by number anywhere in the file ... a triple minting of one name across three files, none citing the others
rows.statement: Step-097 (human-AI organizations) cites no prior step by number anywhere despite re-deriving delegation-chain bounds, majority!=truth, quorum rules and exception authority from steps 086/087; its I_Delegation and I_Responsibility invariant names collide with step-078 and step-087, a triple minting across three uncited files; certifies a majority decision without a quorum precondition, contradicting step-087's own quorum requirement (VG-10).

rows.anchor: VOI is defined net of cost and then compared against cost, double-counting ... reproduce 090 §90.37–90.65 almost point-for-point with new invariant names
rows.statement: Step-098 (economics/resource constraints) substantially duplicates step-090's VOI/graceful-degradation/cache-freshness material under four new near-duplicate invariant names with no citation, and its own VOI formula (net of cost) is applied inconsistently against its own worked example (treating VOI as gross of cost), a double-counting error; its retention-economics mandate directly conflicts with step-088's undischargeable deletion-safety gate (VG-3), neither file acknowledging the other.

rows.anchor: I_SilenceSemantics ... NAMED, NOT DEFINED ... The file demotes its own best formulation when it converts it into an invariant ... the sharpest self-refutation in the scope
rows.statement: Step-099 (observability/runtime measurement), whose thesis is that unobservable invariants are worthless, demotes its own best operational formulation (a required SecurityObservationGap state) into an unfalsifiable prohibition-only invariant (I_SilenceSemantics) one section later -- the sharpest self-refutation in the batch; its dashboard aggregates I_Security (undefined conjuncts), references a never-minted I_ArchitectureConformance (VG-8), and uses a three-state value domain with no Unknown, contradicting step-089's I_VerificationState (VG-4).

rows.anchor: TWO INCOMPATIBLE DEFINITIONS ... The symbolic form is vacuous ... No system behaviour can falsify it ... Four experiments designed as negative controls are scored as confirmations of the theorem
rows.statement: Step-100 (architecture closure test) states two non-equivalent definitions of 'closure' (an unformalized five-predicate prose target, and a symbolic Architecture Closure Theorem quantifying only over Valid transitions); the symbolic form is proven logically vacuous -- satisfied by any system whatsoever, including one performing only unauthorized/untraceable transitions -- and is confirmed operationally when the file's own four negative-control experiments (each violating one conjunct) are all scored PASS.

rows.anchor: WHAT STEP 100 DOES NOT ESTABLISH — PRECISELY ... Closure inherits exactly the epistemic status of its inputs and adds nothing
rows.statement: Step-100's closure claim is enumerated as establishing none of: mutual invariant consistency (~175 invariants, no satisfiability check), individual invariant well-definedness (0 of ~175 pass), a single unified state/decision object (five incompatible D and four incompatible S definitions survive), loop termination/convergence, realizability of any named function (alpha, rho, Update, Impact, F, VOI all unconstructed), correspondence to reality (violating step-089's own I_ModelReality), or sufficiency of the authorization it grants to the next conformance phase; explicitly credited for honestly stating 'Conceptually closed != Empirically proven' even while its own headline verdict box omits that qualifier.

rows.anchor: every one of the eight 'check earlier content' probes ... returned an uncited re-derivation, and in the 022/073 case the re-derivation is weaker than the original

rows.statement: Step-107 (architecture drift analysis) introduces a six-cause discrepancy taxonomy (D1-D6) rated the band's cleanest single contribution, though not proven disjoint (a case can be simultaneously D2 and D3); its Drift tuple changes arity from step-106's 6-ary version to a 9-ary version one step later under the same name, and step-119 later adds an unreconciled third, orthogonal drift taxonomy.

rows.statement: Step-116 (actual graph extraction) introduces a third, differently-ordered E0-E6 evidence scale that rebinds symbols already used with different meanings at steps 108 and 109, meaning earlier boxed verdicts like step-109's E2 silently change meaning under the new binding -- rated the sharpest formal contradiction in the band, ironically made worse rather than better by being the only E-scale to state an explicit total order.

rows.anchor: the sample size executed is zero ... TechnicalVerification=PASS / GovernanceConformance=FAIL ... the band's most valuable single insight
rows.statement: Step-117 (traceability experiment), whose entire design was to trace exactly one real engineering change end-to-end, traces zero real changes and instead fabricates a fictional Nexus upgrade with invented commit/repository/deployment data; nonetheless produces what is rated the band's most valuable single insight (technical correctness does not imply organizational correctness).

rows.anchor: three naming systems for one object set inside one file ... F is bound twice inside this file ... issues six VIOLATION verdicts ... KnowledgeOS was not inspected
rows.statement: Step-120 (constitutional invariants), the band's most valuable structural act (reducing ~50 candidate invariants to seven, C1-C7), simultaneously undermines itself with three unreconciled naming systems for the same seven objects (K1-K7, P/A/E/T/V/R/F, C1-C7) inside one file, an ill-typed intersection formula (set-intersection applied to named properties, mixing a SHOULD-modal conjunct with six MUSTs), a dependency graph three of whose edges are directly refuted by the file's own independence arguments four sections earlier, and six fabricated 'constitutional VIOLATION' verdicts issued without ever inspecting KnowledgeOS.

rows.anchor: On the narrow question the brief poses ... methods, and the files say so ... It fails one level down. The ~470 per-experiment PASS tokens are not hedged
rows.statement: Verifier summary for steps 101-120: every step-level verdict token in 102-119 is honestly self-scoped to a 'model' or 'method' rather than a result, with explicit in-file honesty markers disclaiming result-level claims -- the corpus's self-labelling at that level is accurate; the dishonesty is one level down, in the ~470 per-experiment PASS tokens, which are unhedged, self-confirming, and cannot fail for any reason external to the author, including the band's own seven fabricated FAILs and nine fabricated VIOLATIONs.

rows.anchor: THE BAND CLAIM IS PARTLY WRONG AND IS CORRECTED HERE ... I_Causal was genuinely minted at step-063 ... a scope artifact, not a corpus fact
rows.statement: TV-F-042: supervisory correction of the prior band finding VF-1 -- first-hand corpus-wide grep (not scope-limited to steps 067-082) shows I_Causal was genuinely minted at step-063, six steps before step-069's citation of it, so step-069's reference is legitimate, not phantom; the band's opposite conclusion was an artifact of its own 067-082 scope boundary, not a corpus fact. The residual defect is narrower than reported: 4 of 5 cited names (I_Type, I_Provenance, I_Authorization, I_Conflict) remain phantom, and step-074 separately re-mints I_Causal with different text than step-063's original, an unremarked duplicate mint.

rows.anchor: Two of the seven FAILs ... are additionally circular ... Removal tests establish necessity of each element individually. They never establish sufficiency of the set
rows.statement: TV-F-043 restates and sharpens the step-070 minimal-kernel finding: the false universal quantifier ('each survived a removal test') is exactly one quantifier too strong, since necessity-of-each was never combined with an argument for sufficiency-of-the-set, and identifies a third, non-co-extensive sense of 'kernel' (architectural tier vs primitive tuple vs logical/operational split) used interchangeably in one file.

rows.anchor: There is no cycle ... the general proposition ... is TRUE and is standard. The witness offered for it is INVALID. This is a different and lesser defect class than TV-F-025
rows.statement: TV-F-044 formally computes step-087's Condorcet worked example (two voters A>B>C, one voter C>A) and shows the majority relation is actually transitive with A as Condorcet winner, no cycle; explicitly classifies this as a lesser defect class than an earlier finding (TV-F-025, steps 041-055) where the computed quantity itself was numerically wrong by 10x -- here the general proposition survives, only the illustrative instance fails.

rows.anchor: The token Valid( occurs exactly once in the entire step-100 file ... it is never defined ... the formula is P ⇒ P, a tautology ... SUPERVISORY REFINEMENT of the band's characterization
rows.statement: TV-F-045 (severity CRITICAL) confirms by direct grep that Valid(T) in step-100's closure theorem occurs exactly once, is never defined, and under the only coherent reading collapses the formula to a tautology P=>P; issues a supervisory refinement of the prior band's characterization of §100.34-100.37 as 'negative controls scored as confirmations' -- first-hand reading shows the Expected and Result are actually mutually consistent, so the more precise defect is a scope substitution (the experiments test a weaker proposition than the closure theorem, whose PASSes are then read as supporting closure).

rows.anchor: I_Security is a conjunction over four conjuncts that do not exist ... consumed downstream as evaluable
rows.statement: TV-F-046 restates the I_Security composite-over-undefined-conjuncts finding and its downstream consumption by step-099's dashboard and step-100 as evaluable, plus the adjacent I_ArchitectureConformance/I_RuntimeConformance naming mismatch.

rows.anchor: Across steps 067–082, no file cites any step below 66 ... Four instances of net loss are recorded above
rows.statement: TV-F-047 consolidates the corpus's dominant structural pattern across all three verified bands: eight independent probes of earlier corpus content all returned uncited re-derivation, four of them with net information loss (step-068 losing step-009's AGM critique; step-075 carrying only EVPI where EVSI existed; step-081 as notational churn losing step-031's functional identifiability; step-094 regressing to an unchained hash weaker than step-022's existing hash-chain), one regression (step-078 omitting step-037's adversarial-agent model entirely), and the pattern continuing into 083-100 and 101-120.

rows.statement: TV-F-049 consolidates three independent occurrences of an ill-typed additive '+' applied to quantities the corpus itself proves non-additive: step-077's DecisionDiff over a structureless Decision type, step-079's interaction-term algebra, and step-082's Uncertainty(D)=U_1+U_2+... written 37 sections after the same file proves standard deviations do not add; notes the direct cross-step tension between step-077 assuming and step-079 refuting additive separability of a joint effect.

rows.statement: TV-F-050 tabulates four idea-families independently renamed between step-090 and step-098 (graceful degradation, cache freshness, criticality-proportional effort, constrained optimization) with no citation, plus step-098's internal double-counting of VOI (defined net of cost, then compared against cost as if gross).

rows.anchor: Corpus-wide across 54 files: zero interpreter invocations ... A ~1,490-experiment suite with a ~99% pass rate ... is evidence that the suite cannot fail
rows.statement: Cross-band aggregate for steps 067-120 (54 files): ~1,490 total experiments, ~1,433 boxed PASS, 0 actually executed; invariant census across all three bands shows 64+~175+~50(->7) names minted with only 1 (I_Dependency) genuinely defined as a decidable predicate; states the structural conclusion that a suite this size with a near-100% pass rate, no negative control, and no experiment capable of diverging from its own stated expectation is evidence the suite cannot fail, not evidence of correctness.

rows.anchor: The corpus's own best work (recorded so the critique is not mistaken for dismissal)
rows.statement: Closes with an explicit list of surviving/preserve-worthy results across the 54-file corpus (steps 067-120): I_Dependency (the one executable invariant), two explicit refusals to fabricate an aggregate metric, step-076's unqualified-VALID Pareto treatment, step-073's authenticity-orthogonal-to-truth result, step-071's correctness-vs-reality qualification, step-109's NotFound!=DoesNotExist, step-089's decidability/safety-liveness treatment, step-091's refinement-boundary framing, step-095's RAG reframing, step-107's D1-D6 taxonomy, step-117's technical-vs-organizational-correctness separation, and step-120's invariant-reduction act -- framed explicitly so the critique is not mistaken for wholesale dismissal.

rows.statement: Step-123 (self-verification) correctly states that self-verification must not be its own sole evidence of correctness, then twice violates that exact boundary with two more fabricated constitutional health tables using yet a third and fourth verdict scale, mutually inconsistent with step-122's fabricated table and with each other (C6 = WARN/VERIFIED/PASS across the three; C7 = FAIL/PARTIAL/PARTIAL).

rows.statement: Step-125 (operating model) defines Authority as a Cartesian product where a predicate-over-the-product was intended (an authority is a subset of the product, not the product itself), and its seven-actor capability/decision matrix asserts organizational facts with no cited source, hedged only as 'a working model, not yet a finalized organizational RACI'.

rows.anchor: These are the most disciplined definitions in the band ... ConceptualGrouping ≠ ConfirmedBoundedContext ... criteria 5 (transactions) and 6 (organizational boundaries) are never evidentially satisfied for any context
rows.statement: Step-126 (information model) produces the band's most disciplined set of not-equal distinctions (Evidence!=Knowledge, Decision!=Action, etc.) and its single best methodological warning (ConceptualGrouping!=ConfirmedBoundedContext, naming six validation criteria of which two are never satisfied anywhere downstream); its 15-term relationship vocabulary is given zero arities or domain/range constraints.

rows.anchor: Eight verdicts, six distinct labels, none of which is Confirmed ... The declared scale is abandoned in the same breath it is applied ... Category membership is substituted for evidence
rows.statement: Step-127 (domain/bounded-context test) abandons the three-valued Confirmed/Candidate/Supporting scale it was handed by step-126 within the same application, instead emitting six distinct undefined-intensity labels (never reaching 'Confirmed'); its strongest bounded-context upgrade (Governance = 'Very Strong BC Candidate') substitutes a category claim (governance-authority-belongs-to-roles-in-general) for actual evidence about this system, and only 4 of its own declared 8 DDD criteria are applied per candidate.

rows.anchor: AFR-01 through AFR-36 with no gaps and no re-use of a number. This is the band's one clean identifier series ... a verdict on a strawman proposal nobody made
rows.statement: Step-128 (context map/dependency direction) produces the band's one clean, gap-free, non-reused identifier series (AFR-01 through AFR-36, extended consistently across five later files), each a single testable proposition, but its only FAIL verdict token is issued against a hypothetical strawman nobody proposed rather than any observed system state.

rows.anchor: Two non-identical renderings of 'the core pipeline' in one file ... A fabricated three-line execution result with a specific cardinality (1,248) ... the single most severe execution-evidence failure in the band
rows.statement: Step-129 (architecture fitness model) states three incompatible renderings of its own core pipeline within one file (5, 7, and 9 stages) and three incompatible codomains for its fitness-function F_i, but its most severe defect is a fabricated tool-transcript-shaped result ('Checked: 1,248 objects... Verdict: PASS') carrying no hypothetical marker at all -- rated the single most severe execution-evidence failure in the 121-140 band.

rows.anchor: Drift = ExpectedState − ObservedState ... ILL-TYPED ... asserted ... 138.45 later contradicts precisely this
rows.statement: Step-130 (the assurance graph) proposes a unifying Intent-to-Runtime-evidence graph and correctly assigns epistemic status to edges (not just nodes, a genuine contribution), but overreaches by asserting the graph should become KnowledgeOS's 'semantic backbone' from premises that only establish graph semantics are necessary, not architecturally central -- an upgrade later directly reversed (not cited as such) by step-138.
