rows.statement: Step-131 (logical architecture) correctly refuses architecture-by-fashion and defines the band's only explicitly-defined operator (a strict precedence relation), but its 'strengthen existing architecture before replacing it' principle rests on six unevidenced existence claims about the actual system, with the need to verify that same inventory stated one section later in the same file.

rows.anchor: A FACT label is applied to an unevidenced assertion in the section defining what FACT means ... Thirteen existence assertions, zero evidence rows
rows.statement: Step-132 (current-state reconstruction) declares the band's mode switch from Design to Evidence, introducing a FACT/DERIVED/HYPOTHESIS/TARGET classification that is never mapped onto step-109's near-identical earlier Observed/Inferred/Specified/Claimed scale (that step is never cited); its own worked example applies the FACT label to an entirely unevidenced assertion ('.claude/ contains a memory directory') within the very section that defines what FACT means.

rows.anchor: WHAT EVIDENCE OF INSPECTION IS SHOWN? NONE ... a Java class path, in a repository whose CLAUDE.md declares a Laravel 11 / PHP 8.2 / Vue 3 stack
rows.statement: Step-133 (repository archaeology), the band's most disciplined file (asks questions, answers none, declares an unimplemented deliverable), cites fourteen repository artifacts all inside hypothetical frames ('for example', 'may', 'likely') with zero shell fences, directory listings, or quoted file content; one cited path (domain/KubernetesClient.java) is a Java class name in what is actually a declared Laravel/PHP/Vue repository, itself diagnostic that no repository was ever consulted.

rows.anchor: KnowledgeOS already contains many of the required mechanisms ... WHAT EVIDENCE ROWS DOES IT SUPPLY? ZERO ... the entire back half of the band rests on it
rows.statement: Step-134 (actual repository reconstruction) boxes an unhedged empirical conclusion ('KnowledgeOS already contains many of the required mechanisms') sourced explicitly from 'the KnowledgeOS work already established' (i.e. prior conversational output, not the repository), directly violating the file's own standing rules (ArchitectureClaim!=ImplementationFact, Evidence-before-Architecture-Claims, AAI-01); every one of the band's final six steps (135-140) is shown to build directly on this single unevidenced claim.

rows.anchor: all sixteen rows are ungrounded assertions ... the sole input to 136, 137, 138, 139 and 140 ... STRONGEST DDD REASONING IN THE BAND
rows.statement: Step-135 (semantic ownership matrix) produces the band's strongest DDD reasoning (an authority-edge vs evidence-edge separation, a correct non-inference example, explicit LLM-resolution constraints) but its foundational 16-row ownership matrix is, by the file's own cited evidentiary standard, entirely composed of ungrounded assertions, and becomes the sole input to five subsequent files.

rows.anchor: Every answer is entailed by the ownership matrix the test purports to test ... That is petitio principii, not a discriminating test ... labelled 'Target answer:'
rows.statement: Step-136 (bounded-context boundary tests) presents ten scenarios whose seven boxed 'NO' verdicts are shown to be circular restatements of assumptions already fixed by step-135's ownership matrix (each explicitly labelled 'Target answer' -- the desired, not observed, outcome), so no scenario could have come out otherwise; nonetheless produces the band's most useful violation catalogue (V1-V10), never converted into checks.

rows.anchor: A FORK — VERIFIED BY EXHAUSTIVE GREP ... Three bounded contexts are dropped silently, one is silently merged, three are silently introduced, and the earlier proposal is never named, compared, or rejected
rows.statement: Step-137 (domain model) is shown by exhaustive grep to silently fork an earlier seven-bounded-context proposal from step-052 (Semantic/Causal/Learning contexts have zero occurrences across all 21 in-scope files; Decision Context is silently absorbed into Governance; Assurance/Agent-Platform/Execution are introduced with no antecedent), a direct self-violation of the band's own rule against introducing a target component without first checking whether it exists under another name.

rows.anchor: It is not a refinement; it is a reversal ... Neither 138 nor 140 marks 130 or 131 as superseded ... the band's only explicit TBD, and it sits on the concept that AFR-06, AFR-22, AFR-25, AFR-30 ... all depend on
rows.statement: Step-138 (aggregates/commands/events) reverses step-130's Assurance-Graph-as-semantic-backbone claim (bounded contexts now own state, the graph merely connects it) while mischaracterizing the reversal as 'a very important refinement', with neither step-130 nor step-131 ever marked superseded; also produces ten aggregates for eighteen candidate concepts, the exact noun-per-aggregate anti-pattern step-127 had explicitly warned against, and leaves 'Authorization Context' explicitly TO BE CONFIRMED while six other invariants depend on it.

rows.anchor: The antecedent is established after the consequent has been tabled ... IR-01 ... is the correct formulation ... The two rules are never reconciled: AFR-03 forbids leakage absolutely; IR-01 permits adoption on an invariant test
rows.statement: Step-139 (context map/integration contracts) correctly formulates a superior, invariant-conditioned external-model-leakage rule (IR-01) that directly improves on step-128's unconditional AFR-03, but neither rule is amended or withdrawn and both remain simultaneously live; opens a fifth rule namespace in a band that by this point carries eight unindexed, partially-overlapping identifier namespaces.

rows.anchor: Two logical architectures, nine steps apart, never compared ... classifies anyway, with a rebuttable presumption in place of evidence ... The band ends with its foundational empirical artifact still unwritten
rows.statement: Step-140 (logical component architecture) proposes a five-tier stack incompatible in layer count and graph placement with step-131's six-layer model nine steps earlier (never compared), and inverts the band's own evidentiary burden of proof (defaulting a registry to a positive classification 'unless implementation evidence proves' otherwise, rather than defaulting to Unknown per AFR-10); the band closes with its foundational empirical artifact (the Current Architecture Inventory specified at step-133) never produced by any file.

rows.anchor: Verdict: UNRESOLVED → ABANDONED ... It is not resolved and not rejected — it is dropped ... AFR-01…36 is a de facto successor that no file names as such
rows.statement: Batch-level constitution-lineage finding: step-120's C1-C7 constitution is interrogated honestly (step-121), instrumented then fabricated against (steps 122-123), demoted (steps 124-125), functionally replaced by the AFR-01..36 fitness-rule namespace (steps 128-129, with one explicit but unremarked succession note AFR-02<-C1+C2), then referenced zero times across eleven consecutive files (130-140) -- never versioned, re-tested, or declared superseded, simply dropped.

rows.anchor: 18 intra-scope contradictions catalogued (VI-1…VI-18) ... The band should be read as a competent target-architecture derivation carrying six fabricated result artifacts and an unfounded empirical headline
rows.statement: Band verdict for steps 121-140: 18 numbered contradictions (VI-1 through VI-18) are catalogued spanning fabricated conformance tables, reversed architectural placement decisions, token collisions across three overlapping A0-A6-style ladders, and a silent bounded-context fork; zero empirical acts occur across 694 code fences in 21 files despite an explicitly declared Evidence Mode; the band's own well-articulated epistemic discipline (ArchitectureClaim!=ImplementationFact, AFR-10, Evidence-before-Architecture-Claims, AAI-01) is violated by name in six of its own files, most severely by the single unevidenced claim at step-134.40 on which the band's final six steps rest.

rows.anchor: RA-01…RA-05 ... partially SUPERSEDED by 150, which re-mints the same five rules as RT-001…RT-006 without citing RA-01…05
rows.statement: Step-141 (deployment/runtime architecture) mints five runtime-authority rules (RA-01..05) whose target zone partition (A-E) is never reconciled with its own second, non-isomorphic trust-zone partition (LOWER/MEDIUM/HIGHER/EXTERNAL) in the same file; three of its five rules are silently re-minted nine steps later at step-150 as RT-001..003 with no citation.

rows.anchor: CURRENT ≠ TARGET ... the file violates its own rule on first use ... The load-bearing failure of the band: everything from 143 onward is a delta computed against an unmeasured CURRENT
rows.statement: Step-142 (current-state runtime archaeology) states the discipline CURRENT!=TARGET and forbids HYPOTHESIS->CURRENT without evidence, then immediately violates it by claiming 'we already have evidence of a distributed agent-engineering environment' with no file opened and no path resolved -- flagged as the load-bearing failure of the entire band, since every subsequent delta analysis (143 onward) is computed against this unmeasured CURRENT state.

rows.anchor: §143.8/143.9 genuinely REFRAMES the naive authority ordering ... near-verbatim the C1–C7 of Step 120 ... re-derived under different wording without citing 120
rows.statement: Step-143 (current-to-target delta) produces the band's strongest single reasoning act (AuthorityType=f(Context,ClaimType), refusing a universal AUTHORITATIVE>EVERYTHING ordering), but its Work Package 20 'Architecture Constitution' Rules 1-7 are near-verbatim restatements of step-120's already-existing C1-C7 constitution, proposed as future work without citing that it already exists.

rows.anchor: Do not build KnowledgeOS horizontally ... ArchitectureFitness = Check(GoldenTraceCompleteness) ... 154.51 later concedes the opposite ... without withdrawing
rows.statement: Step-144 (evolution roadmap) asserts ArchitectureFitness=Check(GoldenTraceCompleteness), an unsupported equality between a scalar quality and a single boolean check, later directly contradicted (without withdrawal) by step-154's own concession that MachineAssurance!=CompleteArchitectureGovernance; its vertical-slice/workstream/phase numbering carries three unreconciled counts (6/7/7).

rows.anchor: the band's single most developed formal object is silently dropped six steps after being minted ... GT-005 ... GT-008 ... UNKNOWN ≠ PASS
rows.statement: Step-145 (Golden Trace specification) mints 28 invariants across five families (GT/GG/GE/GC/GA), of which by strict count only 2 are directly checkable, 14 checkable once a schema exists, 2 behaviourally testable, 5 undefined, and 5 are type-distinctness assertions rather than system properties; its boxed 'UNKNOWN != PASS' platform invariant and the entire Golden Trace apparatus are silently abandoned six steps later with no supersession, refutation, or acknowledgement anywhere in the rest of the corpus.

rows.anchor: MIXED, leaning NAMES — 4 genuine, 12 named ... commits it anyway on 12 of 16
rows.statement: Step-146 (implementable domain model) states a correct DDD aggregate-boundary test ('what invariant would be broken if these objects were updated separately') but applies it to only 4 of 16 candidate aggregates, leaving 12 as field-list names rather than genuine consistency boundaries despite being explicitly aware of this exact failure mode; its own aggregate map is later silently replaced wholesale by step-157 with 8 aggregates deleted and 6 added, unacknowledged.

rows.anchor: YES for communication, NO for ownership ... IC-002 ... sets exactly the test the matrix should have passed ... and the matrix passes it for none of its rows
rows.statement: Step-147 (domain events/integration contracts) correctly assigns every command and event to a named owning context (genuine communication boundaries) but its own 9-row consistency matrix assigns Strong-consistency to five transitions with no business-invariant justification cited for any of them, directly failing the very test (IC-002) the same file states 30 sections later.

rows.anchor: the anti-hallucination architecture ... a genuine structural insight ... API design = Governance enforcement boundary ... Circular
rows.statement: Step-148 (API/contract architecture) produces the band's single strongest architectural argument (Agent cannot SetClaimVerified(true) directly; must RequestVerification from a DeterministicChecker), but its closing identity 'API design = Governance enforcement boundary' is circular, since it is true only if the very API-001/API-007 rules it is meant to justify already hold.

rows.anchor: boxed ARCHITECTURE: CONCEPTUALLY VALIDATED ... directly contradicts §48's own ruling ... H-PROV-001 demands ... the document minting H-PROV-001 does not satisfy H-PROV-001
rows.statement: Step-156A (an out-of-sequence Chapter-4 stress test, misfiled and later shown to actually belong ~27 minutes after step-155) states the Gita-lens discipline more rigorously than anywhere else in the corpus (the text cannot empirically validate software architecture) then immediately violates its own rule by boxing 'ARCHITECTURE: CONCEPTUALLY VALIDATED' and an 18-row 'Strongly reinforced' matrix; its own H-PROV-001 (provenance must be reconstructable) is violated by the document itself, since its cited Gita source text is absent from the repository.

rows.anchor: technology restraint ... The most restrained file in the band ... DATA-001 ... directly violates DATA-001 published 33 sections later in the same file
rows.statement: Step-149 (persistence/data architecture) is rated the most restrained and cleanest-invariant file in the band (three explicit acts of refusing premature polyglot/blockchain technology) and is the only file in the entire 22-file band to emit zero unearned PASS/FAIL verdict tokens; its own ownership matrix nonetheless assigns a disjunctive owner ('Action | Action/Agent'), directly violating its own DATA-001 ('exactly one logical owner') stated 33 sections later.

rows.anchor: Instruction ≠ Enforcement ... the band's sharpest security statement ... RT-004 is CIRCULAR
rows.statement: Step-150 (runtime architecture) produces the band's sharpest security statement (an AGENTS.md instruction is not a security boundary; Instruction != Enforcement) but its own fail-closed invariant RT-004 is circular, delegating the definition of 'high-risk' to a governance body that does not exist anywhere in the corpus -- the third of three invariants in the band (RA-02, IC-008, RT-004) gated on an undefined 'high-risk' term.

rows.anchor: the clearest file in the band ... The rule R-NEXUS-001 is nevertheless never grounded ... it remains a tautology ... The band's only file that designs real tests is also the band's clearest evidence that none were run
rows.statement: Step-151 (vertical slice v0.1) is rated the clearest file in the band, twice stating an anti-invention discipline ('the actual rule must come from existing governance material, not be invented for the demo') and then immediately violating it with an ungrounded tautological placeholder rule; produces the only two genuinely designed tests in the entire 158-step corpus (a projection-rebuild test and a determinism test), yet the slice itself is never built and drops out of the corpus entirely after step 155.

rows.anchor: THE TWO CONSTITUTIONS ... There is no supersession, so there are two live constitutions ... Two of seven v0.1 rules have no v1.0 counterpart at all ... a regression, not a release
rows.statement: Step-152 (Implementation Architecture Constitution v1.0) mints 40 rules (C-001..C-040) with no citation of, comparison to, or supersession claim over step-120's existing 'Architecture Constitution v0.1' (C1-C7) thirty minutes earlier in the same corpus; mapping the two shows two of the seven original epistemic rules (Epistemic Separation, Feedback) have no v1.0 counterpart at all, a regression presented via a version-number bump that conventionally signals maturation rather than substitution; also ships a second internal ID namespace (ARCH-*) for a non-identical subset of the same 40 rules, and its very first rule (C-001, one-owner-per-concept) is published against step-149's own data, which already violates it.

rows.anchor: the most precisely specified artefact in the band ... registers as CONFIRMED a list it simultaneously declines to confirm ... the Registry's first act is to contradict the domain model it is supposed to declare
rows.statement: Step-153 (architecture registry) is rated the most precisely specified artefact in the band (seven single-predicate REG invariants, all decidable over a YAML tree), but registers seven bounded contexts as CONFIRMED in the same breath its own caption declines to confirm them, and that seven-context list already contradicts step-146's six-context aggregate map; its verdict tables print specific fabricated result counts (e.g. '47 PASS, 1 WARNING, 0 BLOCKING') with no registry file, scanner, or repository scan behind them.

rows.anchor: A static call-graph shape does not establish that no execution path bypasses authorization ... the file identifies the right property and specifies a check that cannot decide it
rows.statement: Step-154 (self-assurance engine) correctly identifies that authorization-bypass-freedom is a path-universal property, then specifies only a single-path static check plus one runtime scenario as if their conjunction closed the gap, which it does not; its four independent fabricated dashboard result sets (42/47/128/19/7 PASS counts) are shown to be mutually inconsistent with step-153's own fabricated counts, itself proof both are decorative rather than derived from any common imagined run.

rows.anchor: Conformance ≠ GovernanceApproval ... the most valuable single distinction in the band ... This is the one file in the band I can find no invalid inference in
rows.statement: Step-155 (governance runtime) is the only file in the entire 141-158 band judged to contain no invalid inference, producing what is rated the band's most valuable single distinction (code can technically conform to an architecture that has not been approved -- Conformance!=GovernanceApproval); honestly leaves its central object (organizational authority) undefined by design, correctly declining to invent an organizational mapping the corpus does not have.

rows.anchor: CONTRADICTS 156A's own procedural ruling ... 156v1 executes Step 156 without 155A ... the mandated insertion is skipped and then retro-fitted
rows.statement: Step-156 (v1, operating model) is written in direct violation of step-156A's own explicit procedural instruction to insert a Step 155A before Step 156, executing anyway and adopting a linear epistemic-status ladder that the deferred 155A will shortly rule out by name; is later silently superseded by a second, differently-verdicted Step 156 document with no supersession notice, in a corpus whose own D-INV-004/KOS-EPI-010/REG-006 all mandate exactly such notices.

rows.anchor: the most rigorous definitional work in the band ... the single best formal object in the corpus ... PASSED — ARCHITECTURE STRENGTHENED ... A step cannot simultaneously PASS and carry five mandatory unmet requirements
rows.statement: Step-155A (epistemic/provenance kernel review) produces what is rated the single best formal object in the entire corpus (a four-orthogonal-dimension claim model -- TruthStatus/EpistemicStatus/AuthorityStatus/VerificationStatus -- replacing a one-dimensional status, plus a correct mathematical refusal of a linear 'truth ladder'), yet boxes an unqualified PASSED verdict alongside five self-declared 'mandatory' unmet follow-up requirements, none of which is ever discharged anywhere in the corpus; also declares its Epistemic Kernel 'not a bounded context' and then draws it spanning all contexts, which is precisely the shared-kernel structure it names as a hazard.

rows.anchor: SUPERSEDES 156v1 silently — same step number, same title, no supersession notice ... Golden Trace: 0 mentions ... fallen out of scope without a word
rows.statement: Step-156 (revision, operating model) silently rewrites and replaces the first Step 156 document with no supersession field, in a band whose own invariants mandate exactly such notices; the entire Golden Trace/Registry/vertical-slice apparatus built across steps 144-154 disappears from this and all subsequent files with zero mentions and no acknowledgement of the abandonment.

rows.anchor: This is the band's largest structural break ... 8 aggregates deleted, 6 added, 0 acknowledged ... twelve invariants across five families now quantify over objects with no owner in the final model
rows.statement: Step-157 (domain model/bounded-context validation) is shown by exhaustive comparison to silently replace step-146's aggregate map wholesale (deleting RuleAggregate, FindingAggregate, PolicyAggregate, AgentAggregate, SessionAggregate, TaskAggregate, RecommendationAggregate, ExecutionRecord; adding six new aggregates), orphaning at least twelve invariants across five different rule families that quantify over the now-deleted Rule and Finding concepts; it also specifies the corpus's own falsification test as the next step ('Step 158 — Architecture Conformance Audit', a 16-point read-only discovery sequence) explicitly framed as answering 'have we merely constructed an elegant theory around it?' -- a step that is never executed by any subsequent file.

rows.anchor: Neither is produced ... the two files that follow substitute Gītā material and defer it twice. The corpus terminates one step short of its own empirical test
rows.statement: The file misnamed 'step-158-preparation' and the untitled terminal file both explicitly defer to a Step 158 that is never executed, and both abandon their own stated pre-158 deliverables (a Chapter 4 verse-by-verse matrix, a cumulative Chapter 1-4 comparison); the terminal file additionally and explicitly reverses the corpus's own Gita-lens discipline in its opening sentence ('these are not just metaphors... they can become design principles'), boxing two architectural principles (IV-A, IV-B) whose sole warrant is the religious text, without checking whether the claimed gap (a missing prohibition/restraint layer) already exists in the corpus -- verified false for four of the file's own six claimed missing action-guidance values.

rows.anchor: CORRECTED AUTHORING-ORDER TIMELINE ... filename timestamps in this corpus are export events, not authoring events, and cannot be used to establish precedence
rows.statement: Special Task 1 reconstructs the true authoring order from content self-positioning statements (each file naming what step it follows/precedes) rather than filename timestamps, discovering that step-156A's filename timestamp places it 27 minutes before it could actually have been written (it quotes step-154's diagram and references 'Steps 1-155'), and that a cluster of four byte-identical duplicate files appearing within a 21-second window is a re-export/refiling event rather than authoring -- concluding filename timestamps in this corpus are export events, not authoring events, and that any process ordering the corpus by filename would invert this dependency.

rows.anchor: GĪTĀ-LENS DISCIPLINE ... The discipline was correctly stated once ... correctly held three times ... and abandoned in the final document ... the abandonment is not accidental
rows.statement: Special Task 5 tracks the corpus's own stated Gita-lens rule (the text is an external conceptual lens for testing architecture, never itself an architectural dimension or a source of empirical validation) across five files in sequence: violated by the same file that states it (156A, self-contradicting), held compliant by three consecutive files (155A best-in-corpus, 156-revision, 157 fully compliant), borderline in a fourth (135842), and explicitly and deliberately reversed as a stated methodological choice in the corpus's final file (140338) -- with nothing following to catch the reversal.

rows.anchor: IS A PROHIBITION/RESTRAINT LAYER ACTUALLY MISSING? ... It is largely false; the six values are already expressible, four of them exactly, and the file does not check
rows.statement: Special Task 4 tests the terminal file's central claim (that a 'Wisdom' layer converting knowledge into action-or-restraint is missing from the architecture) against the actual corpus and finds it largely false: four of six claimed-missing ActionGuidance outcomes (DON'T, WAIT, INVESTIGATE, ESCALATE) are already exactly and heavily specified across steps 145/146/147/152/154/155/156, with only the deontic modality 'Required' (obligation, as opposed to permission/prohibition) genuinely absent from the entire prior corpus.

rows.anchor: The phase named phase_measure_theory ends with no measure-theoretic content whatsoever, and no file records the abandonment
rows.statement: Batch-level finding: a grep across all 22 in-scope files for tuple/sigma/measure/probability-related terms returns zero hits, meaning the corpus directory's own namesake ('phase_measure_theory') and its founding critiqued object (a substrate/epistemic-representation/relations/transitions tuple) have entirely vanished from the band with no file recording the abandonment; the nearest surviving descendants are dependency declarations, not actual functions or measure spaces.

rows.anchor: Verdict codomain drift — five incompatible definitions, none superseding another ... GT-004 ... is untypable under 154, 156 and 157, because UNKNOWN is not in their codomains
rows.statement: Batch-level finding: the verification-verdict codomain drifts through five incompatible definitions across the band (145's PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN, 151's FAIL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, 154's six-value set dropping UNKNOWN, 156's INCONCLUSIVE-based four-value set, 157's two further variants), with no supersession recorded for any transition, leaving step-145's GT-004 invariant literally untypable under three of the five later codomains because its required UNKNOWN value no longer exists in them.

rows.anchor: Rules-live-once, systematically violated ... Approximately 169 invariant IDs are minted across the band in 15 families with zero cross-family references and zero deduplication
rows.statement: VJ-9: one rule (a governed action requires authorization) is independently minted seven times under seven different identifiers across seven files (KOS-ARCH-002, AF-002, GT-002, A-INV-003, IC-008, API-003, C-018/C-019/ARCH-AUTH-001) with none citing any other; similar five-way duplicate clusters exist for 'verification identifies exact rule version', 'projections must be rebuildable', and 'agent memory is not authoritative' -- roughly 169 invariant IDs total minted across 15 families in the band with zero cross-family references and zero deduplication.

rows.anchor: The four findings that determine the band's status ... The corpus violates its own rules on itself
rows.statement: Verifier summary for steps 141-158: zero execution anywhere across 198 PASS/FAIL tokens (11 fabricated, mutually-inconsistent result blocks); the corpus's own designated falsification test (Step 158) was specified in full and never executed; the formal apparatus of steps 144-154 (Golden Trace, Registry, 28 invariants) is abandoned without supersession; and the corpus is shown to violate, on itself, several of its own explicitly stated rules about provenance reconstructability, valid-time-vs-recording-time separation, supersession recording, and one-owner-per-concept.

rows.anchor: TRACE ≠ VERIFICATION ... MENTIONED ≠ DEFINED ... PASS ≠ PROOF ... RATIFIED ≠ MATHEMATICALLY TRUE ... LATER ≠ SUPERSEDING
rows.statement: States a nine-item chain of non-equivalences to preserve throughout verification: Trace!=Verification, Mentioned!=Defined, Defined!=Well-defined, Well-defined!=Derived, Derived!=Proven, Computable!=Computed, Test-specified!=Test-executed, PASS!=Proof, Ratified!=Mathematically-true, Later!=Superseding.

rows.anchor: D1 — Existence ... D10 — Operational observability ... Can KnowledgeOS obtain the information required to instantiate it?
rows.statement: Defines a ten-point D1-D10 definition test battery (existence, domain, codomain, typing, totality/partiality, uniqueness, non-emptiness, constructibility, computability, operational observability), the last asking specifically whether KnowledgeOS itself could obtain the information needed to instantiate the object.

rows.anchor: Premise 1 ... Inference 1 ... Apply the first-invalid-inference rule: Once an inference fails, do not continue treating downstream conclusions as established
rows.statement: Requires reconstructing every important derivation independently as an explicit premise-to-conclusion chain and applying a first-invalid-inference rule: once one inference in a chain fails, all downstream conclusions must be marked conditional on repairing it, not treated as separately established.

rows.anchor: DEFINED ↓ INPUTS KNOWN ↓ CONSTRUCTIBLE ↓ COMPUTABLE ↓ ACTUALLY COMPUTED ↓ TESTABLE ↓ ACTUALLY TESTED ... Do not collapse these levels
rows.statement: Defines a seven-rung computability ladder (DEFINED, INPUTS KNOWN, CONSTRUCTIBLE, COMPUTABLE, ACTUALLY COMPUTED, TESTABLE, ACTUALLY TESTED) with an explicit instruction never to collapse the levels together.

rows.anchor: Particular attention must be paid to the already discovered conflicts around: uncertainty taxonomies, belief versus probability, Dempster combination ... SNF measures, scalarisation, model uncertainty, identifiability. Do not repair these silently
rows.statement: Directs specific statistical-audit attention to nine already-discovered conflict areas (uncertainty taxonomies, belief-vs-probability, Dempster combination, likelihood construction, independence, uncertainty conservation, SNF measures, scalarization, model uncertainty/identifiability) with an explicit instruction not to repair them silently during verification.

rows.anchor: If two terms mean different things, do not merge them. If two terms appear to mean the same thing, prove that equivalence from the corpus before merging them
rows.statement: States the UL-merging discipline: distinct-meaning terms must never be merged, and apparently-identical terms may be merged only after the equivalence is proven from the corpus, not assumed; a survivor glossary may be produced only after this evidence review.

rows.anchor: multiple competing meanings of kernel. Do not select one merely because it looks elegant ... mathematical primitive kernel; epistemic kernel; DDD shared kernel; architectural kernel; implementation/kernel substrate ... If primitive X is removed, can the remaining primitives still derive everything claimed to depend on X?
rows.statement: Names five distinct senses of 'kernel' already competing in the corpus (mathematical primitive kernel, epistemic kernel, DDD shared kernel, architectural kernel, implementation/kernel substrate) that must be kept separate rather than collapsed by aesthetic preference, and requires deriving any final mathematical kernel through explicit removal testing (if primitive X is removed, can the rest still derive everything claimed to depend on X) rather than selecting it.

rows.anchor: V = { x | I1(x) ∧ I2(x) ∧ ... ∧ In(x) } ... Determine whether: V is non-empty; V is empty; V is unknown; V is non-empty only under additional assumptions. If the invariant system is unsatisfiable, the theory cannot simply be declared valid
rows.statement: Formalizes joint invariant satisfiability as V={x | I1(x)^...^In(x)} and requires explicitly determining whether V is non-empty, empty, unknown, or non-empty only under stated additional assumptions, with an explicit rule that an unsatisfiable invariant system blocks declaring the theory valid.

rows.anchor: CORPUS_ESTABLISHES ... VERIFIED_DERIVATION ... ACTUALLY_EXECUTED ... AUTHOR_ASSERTION ... VERIFIER_RECOMMENDS ... DESIGN_CHOICE ... OPEN ... CONTRADICTED ... Never silently transform a VERIFIER_RECOMMENDS statement into CORPUS_ESTABLISHES
rows.statement: Defines an eight-category classification every final verification statement must carry (CORPUS_ESTABLISHES, VERIFIED_DERIVATION, ACTUALLY_EXECUTED, AUTHOR_ASSERTION, VERIFIER_RECOMMENDS, DESIGN_CHOICE, OPEN, CONTRADICTED), with an explicit prohibition on silently upgrading a VERIFIER_RECOMMENDS statement into CORPUS_ESTABLISHES.

rows.anchor: The current corpus contains many contradictions. That is valuable evidence. During verification: record them first. Do not silently: rename symbols, merge tuples, select one definition, repair signatures, invent assumptions, change terminology, reinterpret equations, declare later documents authoritative
rows.statement: States the critical no-silent-repair rule during verification: contradictions are valuable evidence to be recorded first; the verifier must not silently rename symbols, merge tuples, select one definition among competing ones, repair signatures, invent assumptions, change terminology, reinterpret equations, or declare a later document authoritative -- any repair belongs explicitly under VERIFIER_RECOMMENDS or DESIGN_CHOICE, kept visibly separate from the verified historical record.

rows.anchor: Keep TRACE coverage and DEEP-VERIFICATION coverage as separate metrics. Never report: 205/205 traced = 205/205 verified
rows.statement: Requires tracking trace-coverage and deep-verification-coverage as two separate metrics after each major step band, with an explicit prohibition on conflating a full trace count with a full verification count (e.g. never reporting '205/205 traced' as if equivalent to '205/205 verified').

rows.anchor: What must be true for KnowledgeOS to be mathematically valid, and does it actually follow ... The verifier's job is not to make the theory succeed. The verifier's job is to determine what actually survives
rows.statement: States the final governing question for the whole verification programme and its closing principle: the verifier optimizes not for producing a beautiful theory but for a truthful, auditable, mathematically defensible determination of what survives, explicitly accepting that the outcome may be partially correct, under-specified, internally inconsistent, incomplete, or a small valid theory surrounded by unsupported claims.

rows.anchor: Class 1 — Same object, incompatible definitions ... K_t: 7+ incompatible tuple forms ... Zero: 9 signatures ... Eight distinct 'epistemic object' tuples
rows.statement: Class 1 of the AC register catalogues 16 same-object-incompatible-definition contradictions (C-001..016) in the pre-067 corpus: K_t has 7+ incompatible tuple arities none retracted; S_t has 4 arities; Zero has 9 signatures with a silently-varying third argument; DC(d)/EC tuples conflict 6-vs-7 and 2-/4-/9-tuple; eight distinct 'epistemic object' tuples with no mapping between any two; five uncertainty taxonomies (8/5/7/2/3-way) unreconciled; an Assessment-vs-Assertion vocabulary schism; two disjoint 'kernel' candidate sets (049's 8 primitives intersect 162's 7 kernel candidates at zero tokens); and two Policy signatures mutually uncited.

rows.anchor: Class 2 — Law-level conflicts ... Monotonicity: step-004 axiom vs demonstrated non-monotonicity ... Commutativity/associativity required ... vs denied universally with counterexample
rows.statement: Class 2 of the AC register catalogues 34 law-level contradictions (C-020..053) in the pre-067 corpus, including: a monotonicity axiom (S+(E union {e}) >= S+(E)) directly contradicted by a demonstrated non-monotone case (0.977->0.728) and a separate universal-refutation result, with the candidate scope-distinction that would resolve it left unstated in the corpus; commutativity/associativity required by one file and denied-with-counterexample by another, mutually uncited; idempotency required as a kernel invariant while resting on an evidence-identity notion the corpus itself marks Unresolved; a Lord/Sarathi role-reversal within one series (deciding authority flips between the two roles with no supersession); three silent formal regressions (Beta-Bernoulli reliability to qualitative, strong-Kleene tables to a status set with no connective semantics, a five-time temporal model to three times) none of which any file notes as a loss; and a mathematically invalid likelihood-ratio factorization (LR(E1,E2)=LR(E1)*LR(E2)) gated on only one of two required conditional-independence assumptions, producing a verified 10x overstatement of evidential support that propagates into two later files.

rows.anchor: Class 3 — Notation collisions ... 𝓔 (entity/evidence/events/status-set/input-space) ... No global symbol table exists anywhere in the corpus
rows.statement: Class 3 of the AC register documents corpus-wide glyph overloading as a systemic finding: at least twelve symbols (script-E, script-P, script-C, A, script-K, delta, alpha, Pi, H, T_tau, W_t, U) each carry between two and five unrelated meanings across the corpus, with H mixing hypothesis/entropy/history within a single expression in one file, and explicitly states no global symbol table exists anywhere in the corpus; also catalogues undefined symbols appearing inside results the corpus itself labels 'frozen'/load-bearing.

rows.anchor: Class 4 — Phase-2B ... step-002 §5 defines e1≺e2 ... §6 Case B uses the reverse ... two overlapping transition-operation alphabets over the same carrier K, same day
rows.statement: Class 4 (Phase-2B, steps 001-010 deep read) finds: a precedence-relation orientation (e1<e2) defined one way at its birth section and used in the opposite orientation two sections later in the same file, never fixed anywhere in steps 001-010; two overlapping 8/9-operation transition alphabets minted the same day over the same carrier with no reconciliation, later joined by a third partially-overlapping event set; and a systemic invariant-namespace collision affecting every bare single-letter invariant ID (A, U, S, C, T, I, D) traced back to the corpus's first 25 steps, established as the origin of a pattern that recurs through the later step-158-region registry chaos.

rows.anchor: Class 5 — Phase-2C 025-series ... Zero has ten unreconciled definitions corpus-wide ... Lord/Sārathi roles reversed within the 025-series ... Three silent formal regressions
rows.statement: Class 5 (025-series deep verification) finds Zero accumulates ten unreconciled definitions corpus-wide (five carried from Class 4 plus four more minted inside one single file); a status set declared with 9 values but used with 11 and never re-closed, with one predicate name simultaneously used as an element, a set-function, and a predicate (ill-typed); a Lord/Sarathi decision-authority reversal within the 025-series itself with no supersession act; a second confirmed mathematically-invalid likelihood-factorization instance (same defect class as C-067, independently occurring); an evidence-tuple schism (a 10-field epistemic tuple vs an unrelated 8-field cryptographic tuple sharing one symbol); and a closure claim over a state space that is never actually constructed, rendering it unfalsifiable as stated.

rows.anchor: Per the anti-reconciliation procedure ... such resolutions are PROPOSED REFINEMENTS, never existing theory
rows.statement: States the register's standing methodological rule: even where a Class-1 contradiction looks resolvable by adding a scoping distinction (e.g. a proviso that would reconcile the monotonicity axiom with its counterexample), such a resolution is recorded strictly as a PROPOSED REFINEMENT and never treated as existing theory -- the final-theory work must trace provenance, test supersession, and classify each variant as equivalent/compatible/incompatible/orthogonal before any reconciliation is accepted.

rows.anchor: Step 158 EXISTS, declares itself the reality test, and performs no act on reality (SUBAGENT CORRECTION) ... the corpus ends on an open deferral. VERIFIER OBSERVATION — THE BAND CLAIM IS FACTUALLY WRONG
rows.statement: TV-F-056: supervisory correction of the prior band claim that Step 158 was 'never executed' -- a raw-titled Step 158 file (and a following Step 159) DOES exist, byte-identically duplicated, written outside the band agent's timestamped-file scope; it opens declaring itself the reality test in step-157's own terms (Conceptual Architecture <-> Actual KnowledgeOS/EKS, an Observed->Derived->Hypothesized->Validated discipline explicitly refusing to treat assumptions as measurements) and then performs zero acts on reality (0 shell/repo-path/inspection-result fences, 12+ boxed claims) -- a sharper finding than 'never written': the corpus's own question about itself is the one question the corpus's own answer to it does not answer.

rows.anchor: Eleven fabricated result blocks in steps 152–154, three of them mutually inconsistent ... A commit identifier appears; no commit was read
rows.statement: TV-F-057 consolidates eleven synthetic tool-output-shaped result blocks across steps 152-154, three individually flagged as mutually inconsistent (47 vs 42 checks; 1 vs 0 BLOCKING) including one that fabricates a commit identifier ('commit abc123') though no commit was ever read; states the band-wide execution tally (198 PASS/FAIL tokens, 0 shell commands, 0 fixtures, 0 repository reads, 0 machine-produced outputs across 22 files) and connects this to the earlier-registered C-087 pattern.

rows.anchor: The authoring handover holds for fifteen steps, then breaks four times in thirty-nine minutes ... 156A mandates an insertion and is overruled by the next file
rows.statement: TV-F-058 confirms the clean 15-step authoring handover (141-155) breaks four times in 39 minutes: step-156A's explicit ordering mandate is overruled by the immediately following file, step-155A is retrofitted after the step it was meant to precede, Step 156 is silently rewritten with no supersession marker, and Step 156v1's forward pointer (naming Step 157 a model-'Reduction') is renamed away by the rewrite, with the reduction question never actually answered; restates the filename-timestamps-are-export-events finding as material because it directly violates the corpus's own valid-time/recording-time separation rules.

rows.anchor: The formal apparatus of steps 144–154 is abandoned without supersession ... one rule ... independently restated seven times
rows.statement: TV-F-059 confirms the Golden Trace/Registry/28-invariant apparatus built across steps 144-154 drops to zero mentions from step 155A onward, with step-157's aggregate map orphaning twelve invariants across five families by deleting the Rule and Finding concepts they quantify over; notes this is the same abandonment pattern as the earlier C-094 finding (the C1-C7 constitution abandoned across steps 130-140), recurring one band later at larger scale.

rows.anchor: The corpus violates its own rules on itself, in five independently checkable ways ... A programme whose central thesis is that architecture must be continuously verified against evidence fails its own five rules on the very documents that state them
rows.statement: TV-F-060 tabulates five independently checkable instances of the corpus violating its own stated rules on its own artifacts: reconstructable-provenance rules violated by step-156A's own untraceable source text, valid-time/recording-time separation violated by its own filename timestamps, supersession-recording rules violated by two unmarked live Step-156 documents and two unmarked live constitutions, every-blocking-rule-needs-a-checker violated by six of eight rules lacking one at mint time, and one-owner-per-concept violated by step-149's own ownership matrix.

rows.anchor: Duplicate and refiling hygiene: four byte-identical pairs, no revision markers anywhere ... a full document was re-issued for one character
rows.statement: TV-F-061 catalogues four byte-identical file pairs (steps 129, 133, 158, 159) plus one 1-character-typo-fix pair (step 127, a full 19KB document re-emitted 35 seconds later with zero revision content) with no revision marker or supersession note on any of them, confirming the 13:44-13:45 refiling burst re-emits three unrelated steps simultaneously, which is why filename order cannot be read as authoring order.

rows.anchor: OVERALL: internally elaborate, locally well-reasoned in five files, entirely unverified ... The step that would have converted claims into evidence ... performed no act on reality
rows.statement: Band-level determination for steps 141-158: DERIVATION is INVALID for 16 of 22 files and VALID for only one (step 155); COMPUTABILITY is NOT REALIZED for all 22/22 files; TEST is NOT_EXECUTED for all 22/22 files; overall judged internally elaborate and locally well-reasoned in five files (149, 155, 155A, 147, 156-rev) yet entirely unverified, with the step meant to convert claims into evidence specified, deferred twice, eventually written eight hours later, and still performing no act on reality.

rows.anchor: the corpus's only measure-theoretic content sits in an unnumbered orphan that no numbered step consumes ... the single largest scope failure in the batch
rows.statement: The unnumbered orphan file preceding Step 186 introduces the corpus's only measure-theoretic apparatus (Dirac observation streams, an evidence measure space, Dempster-Shafer belief/plausibility, a Reconstruction Theorem candidate carefully hedged as 'recorded epistemic trajectory' not 'actual historical reality'), but its evidence measure mu_E is silently a measure on the time-index, not on the evidence set it claims to measure (ill-typed); every one of these constructs is abandoned by silence within one step (Step 186), with no rejection recorded, in a corpus directory literally named 'phase_measure_theory'.

rows.anchor: Val is introduced (§186.2) then abolished (§186.3) ... Axioms M1–M10 are declared 10× in this file and cited ZERO times in 187–205 — a dead registry
rows.statement: Step-186 (mathematical validation of the knowledge-state model) mutates its own central KS tuple twice within one file and mints ten axioms (M1-M10) that are never cited again anywhere in the batch; its inference from absence-of-evidence to a determinate Unknown status is shown to be exactly the 'forced binary collapse' a later step (199) condemns, using a distinction (Unknown_notObserved vs Unknown_notRecorded) the same file created six sections earlier and failed to apply.

rows.anchor: Cap⇒Perm⇒Auth⇒Resp. This implication chain is false ... Source_Truth ≠ Kernel ... the one result that survives unmodified to Step 205
rows.statement: Step-187 (authority as a mathematical object) produces the batch's cleanest definitional work (four distinct relations Cap/Perm/Auth/Resp, explicitly falsifying the naive implication chain between them) and its Kernel/sovereign separation is the one result that survives unmodified through Step 205, but its own Allowed(a,r) formula immediately reintroduces the very implication chain it just proved false, contradicting its own worked counterexample.

rows.anchor: HC is named, boxed as a concept, and never given a codomain ... the two boxed results are mathematically incompatible as stated
rows.statement: Step-188 (hindsight contamination) imports a filtration (monotone information sets) as the batch's single most rigorous mathematical construct, but directly contradicts it by also asserting entropy can increase over time (H(K_t+1)>H(K_t)), which is mathematically incompatible with a filtration's tower-property guarantee of non-increasing conditional entropy; its 'hindsight contamination' concept HC is named and boxed but never given a formula, and the filtration itself is abandoned unused within one step, replaced uncited by a differently-structured five-time model.

rows.anchor: the naïve sequence Supported→Determined→Decided is conceptually wrong ... the batch's only genuine self-refutation of a prior model ... Conflict(p_1,p_2)=I∧C∧T∧¬Compatible ... circular
rows.statement: Step-189 (formal epistemic state) executes the batch's only genuine self-refutation of a prior model (correctly rejecting its own earlier single-lifecycle assumption in favor of three parallel state machines, later ancestor of Step 203's federation), but its own Conflict predicate is circular -- three guard conjuncts plus a fourth conjunct (negated Compatibility) that carries all the actual content and is never independently defined.

rows.anchor: Three cases yielding three different invariants is evidence of divergence, not consistency ... the honest move that generates Step 191
rows.statement: Step-190 (DDD aggregate invariant test), despite being titled a 'test', contains three worked cases whose critical invariants differ from each other (Provenance/Authority/Attribution) and then concludes this shows 'a consistent pattern' -- three divergent results read as convergence, with the claimed common lifecycle pattern imported from an earlier step rather than derived from the cases; does flag its own dangerous term ('meaningful'), correctly generating the next step's problem.

rows.anchor: Σ(m)=1 if ΔD(m)≠0 ... three successive signatures for the same operator inside one file ... forcing every mutation into a binary classification creates false certainty
rows.statement: Step-191 (semantic transition vs technical mutation) proposes a significance function through three successive incompatible signatures within one file, but correctly retains an explicit Unknown classification outcome rather than forcing a binary technical/semantic split, warning that doing so 'creates false certainty'.

rows.anchor: draws a graded ranking of exactly the two elements it just declared unrankable ... Δ_t = Reality_t − Knowledge_t is ILL-TYPED
rows.statement: Step-192 (the boundary of truth) correctly separates six previously-collapsed concepts (Truth/Evidence/Belief/Knowledge/Determination/Decision) but its own partial-order argument for epistemic status is immediately contradicted by a diagram drawing a total, graded ranking of exactly the two states (Refuted, Unknown) it just argued were incomparable; also writes an ill-typed subtraction (Reality minus Knowledge) over a quantity it has just argued is unobservable.

rows.anchor: L_total = T_x − T_v ... a telescoping identity ... carries zero information ... derived immediately after ... a conceptual measure
rows.statement: Step-193 (temporal-epistemic consistency) introduces a five-coordinate time model (a third, unreconciled temporal model in eight steps) and derives a 'useful measurable' total-lag identity that is shown to be a pure telescoping cancellation carrying zero actual information about the pipeline, applying exact arithmetic to quantities the same file two sections earlier called merely conceptual.

rows.anchor: Writing a do-expression does not make it estimable ... the transition from P(Y|X) to P(Y|do(X)) requires an identification step ... that the document never performs
rows.statement: Step-194 (the causal boundary) correctly imports Pearl's do-calculus as a conceptual boundary marker but then computes a causal-effect formula from confounded observational data with no identification step (back-door/front-door adjustment), presenting a formula that cannot actually be computed from anything the architecture stores; also states the same illustrative probability figure as two different values (0.25 and 0.30) in two sections.

rows.anchor: the file converts a detection problem into an axiom ... probabilistic same-as judgements are famously non-transitive — so I_48 and §195.6/§195.32 are in direct tension
rows.statement: Step-195 (identity-continuity model) is the best-cited file in the batch and gives the only relation in scope proper equivalence-relation axioms, but its own transitivity invariant (I_48) is shown to be the definition of equivalence relation restated as a requirement rather than derived, foreclosing the genuinely open reconciliation-mapping problem its own counterexample raised, and stands in direct unremarked tension with its own claim (§195.6) that identity judgments are probabilistic (hence non-transitive in general).

rows.anchor: Gap(a)=AuthorityScope(a)−KnowledgeCoverage(a) ... A retracted symbol used two sections later as a live operand is the batch's clearest instance of a formal object surviving its own refutation
rows.statement: Step-196 (authority-responsibility) re-derives step-187's four-way authority separation as a five-way one without citation, and its own Gap(a) formula (subtracting two untyped, incommensurable quantities) is explicitly retracted as 'not a literal numerical subtraction yet' in the same sentence it is defined, then used as a live operand two sections later to build a DecisionRisk function -- the clearest instance in the batch of a formal object surviving its own author's refutation.

rows.anchor: SPECIAL TASK 5a — CONSERVATION-LAW VERIFICATION ... VERIFIER FINDING: NO. No conserved quantity is exhibited anywhere in Step 197 ... Q(S_t) ⊆ Q(S_{t+1}) is not conservation — it is monotone growth
rows.statement: Special Task 5a formally verifies Step 197's central 'conservation law' claim and finds no conserved quantity is exhibited anywhere: the stated condition Q(S_t) subset-or-equal Q(S_{t+1}) is monotone growth/accumulation, the mathematical opposite of conservation (which requires equality); the three candidate instances offered (provenance growing, identity staying constant, evidence-support unchanged) behave in three incompatible ways and cannot be instances of one function Q; the one genuine invariance actually present in the file (evidence fixed under assessment-only transitions) is stated but never generalized, named, or checked against other transition types, where it visibly fails.

rows.anchor: Twenty-five representability queries with a stated 100% pass rate and no failure criterion are not twenty-five failure cases ... expressiveness does not entail consistency
rows.statement: Special Task 3 formally examines Step 200's whole-system 'coherence test' (25 self-administered 'try to break it' questions, 0 failures found) and shows it cannot support any coherence conclusion: every item is a representability query ('can the architecture represent X'), not a genuine counterexample search against a stated invariant; an inconsistent system is maximally expressive, so a 100% 'yes, representable' rate is weak evidence in the wrong direction; none of the 25 tests the actual internal contradictions this verification independently found (competing epistemic-status enums, competing transition tuples, the filtration-vs-entropy conflict); the file's own honest hedge ('not yet a machine-checked theorem... we must never present Level 1 as if it were Level 3') is stated and then violated four sections later by six unqualified STRONG/PASS-equivalent verdict labels.

rows.anchor: THE STEP-201 FORK ... two mutually exclusive answers ... 201-A executes the freeze ... 201-B places Freeze last in a six-stage pipeline ... irreconcilable on the central question
rows.statement: Special Task 1 identifies a genuine fork in the corpus: two distinct documents both titled 'Step 201', mutually exclusive on the central question Step 200 posed (whether to freeze the vocabulary now). Step 201-A executes an immediate 16-term vocabulary freeze under the rule 'one concept must have one semantic identity'. Step 201-B refuses the freeze, proposing an 80-step, ten-phase adversarial/falsification/statistical-validation/formal-assurance research programme (Phases A-J, steps 201-280) with Freeze placed last, a seven-question burden-of-proof gate for every new concept, and the explicit test 'give the architecture to another reasoning system and ask: find the weakest point, not does this look good'.

rows.anchor: Zero acknowledgement, in any form ... 201-B is a complete orphan — it has zero successors in scope ... every stage that would have produced executable evidence — are unexecuted and unreferenced
rows.statement: Steps 202-205 are shown by grep to cite Step 201-A exclusively (the 'frozen vocabulary') and contain zero references to Step 201-B's phases, review instrument, or burden-of-proof gate; 201-A thereby silently 'wins' the fork by successor capture rather than adjudication, and 201-B's entire adversarial/statistical/formal-assurance programme -- the only part of the corpus that would have produced executable falsification evidence -- is permanently orphaned with no document ever recording the choice between the two.

rows.anchor: THE FREEZE AUDIT ... Determination, Witness, and Conflict-as-object are removed with no supersession record ... invariant set is asymmetric, and the freeze exploits the asymmetry
rows.statement: Special Task 2's freeze audit proves the 201-A vocabulary freeze silently drops three terms (Determination, Witness, Conflict-as-a-representable-object) still required by live invariants at the moment of the freeze (I_34, Axioms M6/M7, I_29-31, I_42, the orphan's Reconstruction Theorem), violating the corpus's own explicitly stated rules that supersession must be recorded (Step 170's 'Superseded != Deleted', I_30, I_42); identifies as the single most consequential structural finding that the corpus's own headline invariant (no semantic elevation without an explicit transition, I_73/196.54) governs only implicit upward moves, leaving implicit downward moves (semantic demotion) completely ungoverned -- a structural asymmetry the freeze exploits, with 201-B's own seven-question gate ('what happens if we remove it') being the exact instrument that would have caught this and was never applied.

rows.anchor: Not every relation is allowed ... the matrix marks only permitted cells ✓ and everything else — ... in which case the matrix establishes no prohibition at all
rows.statement: Step-202 (formal relation matrix) states its purpose is to prove not every concept-relation is permitted, but its 10x10 permission matrix marks only 11 of 90 cells and never states whether an unmarked cell means forbidden or merely undetermined -- under its own 'not yet normative, current hypothesis' hedge the matrix establishes no prohibition at all, undermining the very claim it was built to support; it also re-admits 'Policy' framing it as a fresh discovery of an omission Step 201 supposedly 'deliberately exposed', when Policy was already in live use ten steps earlier.

rows.anchor: KnowledgeOS should NOT have one monolithic state machine ... contradicted by the document's own state enumerations ... 10×8×6×7×5 = 16,800 ... yield ≈720
rows.statement: Step-203 (state-space decomposition) correctly answers Step 200's deferred monolithic-vs-federated question via an independently sufficient semantic argument, but its headline combinatorial argument (a stipulated state-space product yielding 16,800 states) uses cardinalities directly contradicted by the same document's own enumerated state sets (which multiply to about 720) -- the arithmetic is correct, the inputs are fabricated, and the error is decorative rather than load-bearing since the semantic argument alone suffices; rated the strongest DDD file in the whole batch on method.

rows.anchor: T_τ is bound twice in one file ... Commutativity holds only on the projection that forgets lineage, and the file never states that restriction
rows.statement: Step-204 (transition algebra) reproduces Step 198's composability theorem verbatim without citation (including its unresolved subset-vs-implication ambiguity), binds the symbol T_tau to two incompatible structures within the same file, and asserts a commutativity property for concurrent operations that is false under the architecture's own lineage-bearing state model (since causally-tagged events with distinct causationIds produce different lineages under either ordering) -- correct only on an unstated lineage-forgetting projection.

rows.anchor: A four-valued ordinal scale applied to eleven candidates with no rubric ... precisely the failure mode 199.19 identified for scalar confidence ... reproduced six steps later by the same corpus, in a table, unremarked
rows.statement: Step-205 (aggregate derivation) states and correctly applies the right DDD method (derive aggregates from invariants and atomicity, not nouns, explicitly rejecting the 'symmetry trap'), but its own confidence-graded aggregate-candidate table (High/Medium-High/Very High/Low) is produced by no stated rubric from its own six boolean sizing tests -- reproducing, unremarked, six steps later, the exact scalar-confidence insufficiency the corpus itself had identified at step 199; also silently deletes 5 of Step 165's 9 earlier aggregate candidates (Knowledge, Determination, Authorization, Execution, Inquiry) and reverses Step 165's own Observation-subset-of-Evidence conclusion, with no citation of Step 165 anywhere.

rows.anchor: VL-1 ... VL-15 ... Semantic elevation governed, semantic demotion ungoverned ... STRUCTURAL ASYMMETRY, not merely an omission
rows.statement: Batch-level finding: catalogues 15 numbered intra-scope contradictions (VL-1 through VL-15) across steps 186-205, most severely the filtration-vs-entropy-growth conflict, a partial order asserted then drawn as a total order, four incompatible bindings of the Proposition/K_t/T_tau symbols within single files, the 201-A freeze's undisclosed omission of Policy from its own derivation basis, a reversed Observation-Evidence containment relation, and the structural semantic-elevation/demotion asymmetry (VL-13) identified as the freeze audit's central finding.

rows.anchor: 259 fences, 0 executable ... No file in scope contains executed code, a machine-checked proof, a test artifact, or a reproducible witness
rows.statement: Global execution finding for steps 186-205 plus orphan (22 files): a grep for execution/proof/test-tool keywords returns zero hits across all files; the fence-language census totals 259 fences (129 bare, 110 text, 20 text-with-id), all ASCII diagrams or pseudo-schemas, zero executable, confirming zero executed code, machine-checked proofs, test artifacts, or reproducible witnesses anywhere in the band.

rows.anchor: THE STEP-158 COLLISION ... a filename-slug collision, not a content collision ... Internal numbering governs and is unambiguous
rows.statement: Resolves the Step-158 filename collision (a Gita-preparation file and a raw-titled Architecture-Conformance-Audit file both bearing a 'step-158' slug) as purely a naming-convention defect: the timestamped file's own opening sentence places it explicitly before Step 158, and the raw-titled file explicitly declares itself Step 158 -- internal numbering is unambiguous once content self-positioning is checked.

rows.anchor: SPECIFIED ONLY. NOT PERFORMED ... five promised output artifacts ... exist nowhere in the corpus ... the rule is stated and then structurally unenforceable
rows.statement: Step-158's self-declared 'reality test' (a ten-dimension Architecture Conformance Audit comparing conceptual vs observed architecture) is confirmed specified but never performed: its own master matrix contains zero evidence-backed rows, its five promised output artifacts and six gates are never produced or revisited anywhere in the following 27 files, and its own stated evidence rule is never enforced by any successor step.

rows.anchor: VK-3 — SIX INTERNAL TUPLE CONTRADICTIONS INSIDE ONE FILE ... The Evidence case is the most damaging
rows.statement: Step-161 (semantic contract reconstruction) defines the same six core objects (Observation, Inquiry, Evidence, Knowledge, Decision, Authorization) twice within one file with silently altered field sets, most damagingly dropping the 'relevance' field from Evidence that the same file's own central claim (Evidence is contextual) depends on.

rows.anchor: VK-16 — I_1..I_5 five-for-five ID collision ... A reader encountering 'I_3' in this corpus cannot determine which proposition is meant
rows.statement: Step-171 mints a five-invariant registry (I_1..I_5) that collides index-for-index and content-for-content with Step-161's already-existing I_1..I_5, both explicitly framed as candidate constitutional articles, with zero acknowledgement in either direction, rendering any bare 'I_n' citation in the corpus ambiguous.

rows.anchor: VK-9 — I(S;H)<H(H) false when π injective ... The second sentence is correct and contradicts the strict inequality asserted in the first
rows.statement: Step-167's information-theoretic lineage argument misapplies mutual information: since a state projection S=pi(H) is a deterministic function of history H, the mutual information I(S;H) equals H(S) exactly (not strictly less than H(H)) whenever the projection is injective, directly contradicting the same sentence's own correct qualifier ('unless it is injective') -- the architectural conclusion drawn happens to be right but the stated derivation is invalid; the correct non-injectivity argument is properly supplied five steps later at Step 175.

rows.anchor: STEP 169 — GENUINE FALSIFICATION PASS ... the most honest passage in the batch ... the three laws graded highest are the three that were not attacked
rows.statement: Step-169 runs a genuine falsification pass against eight architectural laws with real counterexamples for five of eight plus a whole-architecture minimal-counterexample attack (yielding 'KnowledgeOS must justify every additional abstraction by a problem it solves'), rated the batch's strongest and most honest derivation; but its own results table grades the three laws never actually attacked as its highest-confidence outcomes, inverting the falsificationist logic the file opens with.

rows.anchor: STEP 175 — the batch's most mathematically sound file ... the only reproducible witness in all 28 files ... superseded by §178.37 without acknowledgement
rows.statement: Step-175 correctly frames historical-state recoverability as a statistical identifiability problem and supplies the batch's only genuinely reproducible mathematical witness (two distinct histories 100->80 and 120->80 both reaching current state 80, proving history is not identifiable from current state alone); its boxed three-argument Decision formula is silently superseded three steps later by Step-178's incompatible seven-argument formula with no citation or acknowledgement.

rows.anchor: STEP 178 — Decision=f(Knowledge) REJECTED ... a valid refutation of functional dependence ... $\arg\max$ imported and abandoned
rows.statement: Step-178 genuinely refutes the hypothesis Decision=f(Knowledge) with a valid counterexample (two organizations with identical knowledge but different objectives reaching different, equally rational decisions), replacing it with a seven-argument governance function; the function's own naming uses two of the corpus's most heavily overloaded symbols (E, G), and an imported constrained-optimization formalism (arg max utility) is introduced then explicitly disclaimed five sections later, doing no actual work in the final result.

rows.anchor: STEP 181 — 8-WAY CONFLICT TAXONOMY ... the batch's most disciplined use of statistics ... §181.36 restates it as a 9-valued type
rows.statement: Step-181 genuinely rejects two named conflict-resolution heuristics ('latest wins', 'highest confidence wins') with real counterexamples and correctly bounds a Bayesian likelihood-ratio argument as conceptual discipline rather than a fake oracle (the batch's most disciplined statistical use), but its own 8-member conflict taxonomy is restated as a 9-member type 28 sections later in the same file with an added, unremarked category ('Dispute').

rows.anchor: VK-28 — 5 Confirmed BCs ... No step in scope ever confirmed five bounded contexts ... the exact failure mode the file exists to prevent, committed by the file
rows.statement: Step-180 (rated the batch's most serious single defect, VK-28) asserts a transition from '8 Candidate BCs' to '5 Confirmed BCs' as evidence of epistemic discipline, when no prior step ever confirmed any bounded context -- Steps 173 and 174 explicitly and repeatedly withhold confirmation ('we cannot yet answer conclusively') -- committing, in the very file whose subject is that Unknown must never silently become Established, exactly the failure mode the file exists to prevent.

rows.anchor: VK-31 — THE BOXED Authority HAS NO ACTOR ARGUMENT ... the batch's clearest ill-typing of a headline claim
rows.statement: Step-182's headline boxed result ('there is no universal owner of organizational truth', formalized as Authority=f(Domain,Proposition,Context,Scope,Time)) omits the Actor argument entirely, contradicting both the immediately preceding Step-179's actor-centric authority model and the same file's own worked examples three sections earlier which require an actor argument -- the batch's clearest instance of a headline formula contradicted by its own body.

rows.anchor: VK-37 — I_15..I_20 six-for-six collision ... VK-38 — Executable test designed with an explicit maturity gate, never run
rows.statement: Step-185 mints six constitutional invariants (I_15..I_20) that collide index-for-index with Step-162's already-existing I-15..I-20 (and overlap two prior-corpus registries, with I_11-I_14 never having existed at all), and separately designs a five-case executable classification test with an explicit maturity pass/fail criterion that is never run before the six invariants are shipped anyway -- the batch's terminal instance of specify-and-don't-execute, mirroring Step 158's opening failure.

rows.anchor: Cross-cutting pattern — IMPORT-THEN-DISCLAIM (four instances) ... does no inferential work — a pattern the batch's own meta-law ... forbids and never self-applies
rows.statement: Batch-level pattern: at least four formalisms (constrained-optimization arg-max, expected information gain, a probability-concentration claim, and one properly-used likelihood-ratio) are imported for rhetorical authority and then immediately disclaimed as not literally intended, in three of four cases doing no actual inferential work in the final result -- a pattern the corpus's own meta-law ('use the weakest mechanism that provides the required assurance') explicitly forbids and the corpus never applies to itself.

rows.anchor: Cross-cutting pattern — INDEPENDENT RE-DERIVATION WITHOUT CITATION ... Unknown ≠ False: seven times
rows.statement: Batch-level pattern: several results are independently re-derived without citation multiple times across the 28-file band -- State-does-not-contain-History three times, Capability!=Authority four times, Unknown!=False seven times, evidence non-independence three times, and the four-relation actor model twice -- none of the repeated derivations citing any of the prior ones.

rows.anchor: FIVE in-scope I-registries + six prior-corpus registries in one namespace ... one back-reference in 28 files, and it is fictional
rows.statement: Batch-level finding: across steps 158-185 five separate in-scope invariant registries (161, 162, 171, 185, plus 162's own unnumbered addition) compete with six prior-corpus registries occupying the same I-namespace, producing two six-for-six and one five-for-five content collisions with zero crosswalks; the only invariant back-reference in all 28 files occurs inside a hypothetical imagined AI utterance, not as a genuine citation.

rows.anchor: Overall ... a coherent, largely well-reasoned, entirely unexecuted architectural monologue ... not reasoning errors but bookkeeping failures
rows.statement: Consolidated verdict for steps 158-185: zero execution evidence across all 28 files on every pattern tested, with one mathematical reproducible witness (Step 175); the band's best results (Step 168's multi-dimensional state, Step 175's identifiability proof, Step 184's three protected transitions, Step 185's bitemporality) are genuinely implementable and never implemented; its worst defects are characterized as bookkeeping failures rather than reasoning errors -- fifteen registries with no crosswalks, six definitions of the Knowledge tuple K, eight meanings of the symbol I, and one unlicensed Candidate-to-Confirmed promotion committed by the very file that forbids it.

rows.anchor: The phase is named after mathematics that no numbered step contains ... NOT ONE contains σ-algebra, measurable space, measure space, or Lebesgue ... the single most consequential finding of the verification to date
rows.statement: TV-F-062 (CRITICAL, rated the single most consequential finding of the verification programme to date): a first-hand corpus-wide grep across all 473 files finds zero of the 215 numbered steps contain sigma-algebra, measurable space, measure space, or Lebesgue -- every occurrence sits in four pre-Step-001 research files dated one day before the corpus began, plus the unnumbered orphan; the nearest substitute (Dempster-Shafer belief functions) appears in 22 files but only through step-027 of 215, after which it disappears from the numbered corpus entirely with no recorded rejection or supersession, taking with it the only formalism in which Zero's central property (Unknown!=False) was actually derivable.

rows.anchor: Step 200, the sole whole-system falsification pass, cannot fail ... By the corpus's own I_47 ... none of these labels may be read as verification
rows.statement: TV-F-063 restates and sharpens the Step-200 finding: its 25-query coherence test cannot fail by construction (representability is not coherence), and its own correctly-hedged 'Provisional Coherence Proposition' self-limitation is then violated 17 times by unqualified verdict labels across four subsequent files (200/202/204/205), all of which the corpus's own invariant I_47 (governance approval must not silently upgrade epistemic strength) would disqualify as verification.

rows.anchor: The Step-201 fork is unadjudicated, and the half demanding real testing is orphaned ... The fork was resolved by silence in favour of the half that froze the vocabulary, and against the half that would have tested it
rows.statement: TV-F-064 confirms by grep that Step 201-B's 80-step adversarial/statistical/property-based-testing programme has zero successors in steps 202-205, while 201-A's vocabulary freeze captures the entire successor chain -- the fork is resolved by silence in favor of the less epistemically honest half (201-B explicitly states PROVISIONALLY COHERENT != PROVEN != FINAL, a distinction the successor chain does not carry forward).

rows.anchor: ROOT CAUSE — a structural asymmetry, not an oversight ... One missing dual invariant explains all of them

rows.anchor: Zero executions across 259 code fences ... This continues the corpus-wide pattern without exception: across the ~120 documents deep-verified so far, zero empirical acts
rows.statement: TV-F-069 confirms zero execution markers across 259 code fences in 22 files (all text/ASCII), with only three arithmetically-checkable computations in the entire band, all independently verified (one correct-but-fabricated-inputs, one correct-but-vacuous-telescoping, one correct-but-method-unspecified); states that across roughly 120 corpus documents deep-verified by this point in the overall verification programme, the finding of zero empirical acts holds without a single exception.

rows.anchor: Steps 202–205 each cite only their immediate predecessor and nothing they displace ... a reader cannot reconstruct why the prior conclusions were abandoned

rows.anchor: What survives from this band ... The corpus's own most accurate self-assessments are 200.47 and 201-B's PROVISIONALLY COHERENT ≠ PROVEN ≠ FINAL. Both are correct, and both are contradicted by the verdict labels the corpus then issues

rows.statement: States the kernel question remains unresolved with at least five distinct competing senses (mathematical primitive, epistemic, DDD shared kernel, architectural tier, implementation substrate) plus a sixth internal triple-sense collision within a single step (070), and that 'NO CANONICAL FORM ESTABLISHED' is affirmed as the correct verdict, explicitly forbidding selection of any sense for aesthetic reasons.
